jobs.description:
General Info

- Department: DataOps / IT

- Work time Percentage: 100%

- Location: Geneva

Our Company

EFG International is a global private banking group, offering private banking and asset management services. We serve clients in over 40 locations worldwide. EFG International offers a stimulating and dynamic work environment and strives to be an employer of choice.

Our Purpose and Mission

Empowering entrepreneurial minds to create value – today and for the future.

Job Description

DataOps Service & Governance Engineer

DataOps Services’ mission is to ensure the reliable and efficient servicing of all data interfaces supported by our data platform. This includes a broad spectrum of interfaces, ranging from highly critical order-processing flows to regular analytical and reporting systems. The DataOps team supports global systems serving the entire Group worldwide.

We are looking for a reliable and well-organised expert to join our DataOps team in Geneva. As our platform and data landscape evolve, robust operational governance has become increasingly important. With growing regulatory requirements, rising business expectations for data quality, and the need for consistent service delivery, we must ensure that our processes are well-documented, controlled, and transparent.

In this context, we are seeking a profile dedicated to overseeing documentation, managing Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and monitoring Service Level Agreements (SLAs). By reinforcing these governance pillars, you will help us ensure continuity and quality of operations, while facilitating clear communication and alignment among our technical and business teams.

Key Responsibilities

- Coordinate operational activities related to data integration services under the responsibility of the DataOps Team Manager, ensuring effective change management, quality assurance, SLA monitoring, and comprehensive SOP documentation.

- Monitor and track the smooth operation of critical business processes, acting as the primary contact for SLA- and procedure-related topics.

- Create, maintain, and continuously improve documentation and operational procedures (SOPs) to ensure alignment with internal standards, audit requirements, and applicable regulations.

- Collaborate closely with IT, production support, and business teams to strengthen governance around data integration processes and ensure documentation is accurate, up to date, and consistently applied.

- Ensure traceability, consolidation, and regular updates of performance indicators (KPIs) related to SLAs, operational quality, and service reliability.

- Prepare and contribute to regular service reviews and reporting, highlighting risks, issues, and improvement opportunities.

- Improve internal team processes by gathering stakeholder feedback, identifying pain points, and proposing optimisations to SOPs and workflows in collaboration with the line manager.

- Support incident and problem management from a governance perspective (e.g. post-incident documentation, lessons learned, action follow-up).

- Facilitate effective communication and coordination across teams to support operational excellence and a culture of continuous improvement.

Requirements and Qualifications

- At least 5 years of experience in operational governance, documentation management, service management, or PMO roles within a data-driven or IT/operations environment (e.g. data platforms, integration, production support).

- Proven experience in managing and monitoring SLAs and SOPs, with the ability to structure, validate, implement, and track procedures across multiple stakeholders.

- Strong writing, organisational, and analytical skills, with a demonstrated ability to produce clear, concise, and audit-ready documentation.

- Experience in tracking performance indicators (KPIs), preparing service quality reports, and presenting findings to management and stakeholders.

- Good understanding of data integration and data platform environments; knowledge of Kafka, Opcon orchestrator, microservice architectures, and REST-based communication is a strong plus.

- Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to interact effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and to facilitate coordination across teams.

- High attention to detail, rigor, and autonomy in managing tasks and priorities in a dynamic environment.

- Good command of spoken and written English; French is an asset.

Personal Attributes

- Responsible and reliable, especially during critical operational periods and in the context of production incidents or major changes.

- Methodical, structured, and rigorous in documentation, process management, and follow-up.

- Proactive and a strong team player, with the ability to work effectively within cross-functional and international teams.

- Curious and motivated to learn and grow in a transforming technological environment, embracing change and continuous improvement.

- Comfortable challenging the status quo constructively and proposing pragmatic, risk-aware solutions.

Our Values

- Accountability: Taking ownership for tasks and challenges, as well as seeking continuous improvement.

- Hands-on: Being proactive to rapidly deliver high-quality results.

- Passionate: Being committed and striving for excellence.

- Solution-driven: Focusing on client outcomes and treating clients fairly with a risk-aware mindset.

- Partnership-oriented: Promoting collaboration and teamwork. Working together with an entrepreneurial spirit.

Please ensure to attach a cover letter to your CV when filling the application.

Job Description

DataOps Service & Governance Engineer

DataOps Services’ mission is to ensure the reliable and efficient servicing of all data interfaces supported by our data platform. The DataOps team supports global systems serving the entire Group worldwide.

With growing regulatory requirements, rising business expectations for data quality, and the need for consistent service delivery, we must ensure that our processes are well-documented, controlled, and transparent.

In this context, we are seeking a profile dedicated to overseeing documentation, managing Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and monitoring Service Level Agreements (SLAs). - Erfahrung in Tracking-Performance-Indikatoren (KPIs), der Erstellung von Service-Quality-Berichten und der Präsentation von Ergebnissen für Management und Stakeholder.

- Starke Kommunikation und interpersonale Fähigkeiten, mit der Fähigkeit, effektiv mit technischen und nicht-technischen Stakeholdern zu interagieren und die Koordination über Teams zu erleichtern.
- Hohe Aufmerksamkeit auf Detail, Strenge und Autonomie bei der Verwaltung von Aufgaben und Prioritäten in einem dynamischen Umfeld.
- Gutes Kommando über gesprochenes und geschriebenes Englisch; Französisch ist ein Vermögen.

Persönliche Attribute
- Verantwortlich und zuverlässig, insbesondere während kritischer Betriebszeiten und im Kontext von Produktionsvorfällen oder großen Veränderungen.
- Methodisch, strukturiert und streng in Dokumentation, Prozessmanagement und Follow-up.
- Proactive und ein starker Teamplayer, mit der Fähigkeit, effektiv in funktionsübergreifenden und internationalen Teams zu arbeiten.
- Neugierig und motiviert, in einem sich verändernden technologischen Umfeld zu lernen und zu wachsen, Veränderung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung zu ermöglichen.
- Bequeme Herausforderung des Status quo konstruktiv und pragmatische, risikobewusste Lösungen.

- Rechenschaftspflicht: Eigentum an Aufgaben und Herausforderungen zu nehmen, sowie kontinuierliche Verbesserung zu suchen.

- Curieux et motivé à apprendre et à grandir dans un environnement technologique en transformation, intégrant le changement et l'amélioration continue.
- Confortable défier le statu quo de manière constructive et proposer des solutions pragmatiques et conscientes des risques.

Nos valeurs

jobs.title: EPM OneStream Developer/Business Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Our Company

EFG International is a global private banking group, offering private banking and asset management services. We serve clients in over 40 locations worldwide. EFG International offers a stimulating and dynamic work environment and strives to be an employer of choice.

Our Purpose and Mission

Empowering entrepreneurial minds to create value – today and for the future.

Job Description

The EPM OneStream Developer/Business Data Analyst will be part of the Group Performance Measurement, Budgeting & Reporting Team in Lugano and will contribute to develop and run an integrated planning, reporting and performance review process to facilitate value-driven business decision-making. In his role as EPM OneStream Developer, the resource will oversee running, maintenance and development of our existing OneStream planning platform. In his role as EPM OneStream Developer/Business Data Analyst, the resource will support the performance measurement activities by running granular analysis of financial performance root causes and by providing insights on value creation levers.

The resource will play an active role supporting business development and providing value-added decision support using data modelling and forecasting intelligence.

Main Responsibilities

- EPM OneStream Developer

- Business analyst and power user of MI data

- Design and maintain data models for analysis and forecasting

- Establish and compile dashboards and presentations to senior management

- Take active role in the business performance dialogues

- Active collaboration with Strategy & Corporate Development unit during budgeting and forecasting process

- Design and develop MI reports and simulations with data from the various MIS systems of the bank to provide insight on value creation levers to the business

- Develop strong relationship with business management and business controllers to support the Planning & Controlling business partnership

Skills and experience

- Professional experience in EPM Business Intelligence in Financial Industry

- OneStream software: EPM applications maintenance and developments expert

- Ability to understand large datasets and experience of data modelling, providing accurate data analysis

- Power user of OneStream, MS-PowerBI, MS-Excel and PowerPoint; Knowledge of Excel Macros, VBA, Python, SAS Enterprise Guide to automate data extraction and reporting

- Quick learner, accurate and efficient

- Proactive attitude and willingness to take on new knowledge and skills

- Ability to work under pressure and adapt to unforeseen work demands

- Good communication skills to communicate effectively with stakeholders at all levels

- Fluent in Italian and English

Our Values

- Accountability: Taking ownership for tasks and challenges, as well as seeking continuous improvement

- Hands-on: Being proactive to rapidly deliver high-quality results

- Passionate: Being committed and striving for excellence

- Solution-driven: Focusing on client outcomes and treating clients fairly with a risk-aware mindset

- Partnership-oriented: Promoting collaboration and teamwork. Working together with an entrepreneurial spirit.

EFG International is a global private banking group, offering private banking and asset management services. We serve clients in over 40 locations worldwide. EFG International offers a stimulating and dynamic work environment and strives to be an employer of choice.

EFG is committed to providing an equitable and inclusive working environment that is founded on the principle of mutual respect. Joining our team means experiencing a supportive environment, where your contributions are valued and recognised. We strongly believe that the diversity of our teams gives us a competitive advantage by fostering better decision-making and greater innovation.

Our Purpose and Mission

Empowering entrepreneurial minds to create value – today and for the future.

We are a private bank, offering personalised solutions on a global scale to private and institutional clients. Our sustainable success is based on our talents and on how we partner with our clients and communities to create lasting value.

Job Description

The EPM OneStream Developer/Business Data Analyst will be part of the Group Performance Measurement, Budgeting & Reporting Team in Lugano and will contribute to develop and run an integrated planning, reporting and performance review process to facilitate value-driven business decision-making. In his role as EPM OneStream Developer, the resource will oversee running, maintenance and development of our existing OneStream planning platform. In his role as EPM OneStream Developer/Business Data Analyst, the resource will support the performance measurement activities by running granular analysis of financial performance root causes and by providing insights on value creation levers.

The resource will play an active role supporting business development and providing value-added decision support using data modelling and forecasting intelligence.

Main Responsibilities

  • Take active role in the business performance dialogues

  • Develop strong relationship with business management and business controllers to support the Planning & Controlling business partnership

  • Power user of OneStream, MS-PowerBI, MS-Excel and PowerPoint; Knowledge of Excel Macros, VBA, Python, SAS Enterprise Guide to automate data extraction and reporting

jobs.title: Pension Fund Manager
jobs.description:
## Job Summary

The Pension Fund Manager is in charge of managing and administering the company pension fund, ensuring compliance with current regulations and protection of the interests of the employees of affiliated companies against the economic consequences of old age, death, and disability. He/she coordinates all operational, financial, and administrative activities of the pension fund, in line with the foundation regulations, policies and legal provisions.

## Tasks and Responsibilities

- Overall responsibility for the administrative management, technical-accounting and business activities of Fondazione

- Define the financial and actuarial regulations and parameters underlying the plan in order to achieve long-term financial equilibrium

- Administrative and operational management of the pension fund, including enrolment of members, management of contributions and benefits.

- Supervises the establishment of the Annual Report, the accounting and actuarial reporting to the foundation board and the supervisory bodies as well as the reporting according to IAS 19 to EFG SA

- Coordination with external bodies (actuarial consultants, auditors, supervisory authorities) and service providers (custodian banks, asset managers).

- Supervision of pension fund investments, in accordance with the investment regulations and risk criteria.

- Supervision and control of annual accounts, financial statements and documentation required by supervisory bodies.

- Supporting the Board of Foundation in defining the pension fund's strategy, ensuring the financial stability of the foundation

- Managing communications to members, including information on benefits and regulatory changes.

- Monitoring regulatory developments in the field of pensions and updating internal procedures.

- Supervises the internal control system

- Ensure constant collaboration with the human resources department of EFG SA, agreeing procedures, identifying synergies and jointly analysing common topics

- Prepare and coordinate the meetings of the foundation board and investment committee, drawing up the relevant minutes

- Actively provide pension advice to all insured persons (active employees and pensioners.

## Requirements and Qualifications

- Degree in Economics, Finance, Actuarial Science or related disciplines.

- Proven experience in the management of pension funds, provident funds or similar institutions.

- Sound knowledge of pension legislation (e.g. LOB in Switzerland or equivalent local legislation).

- Expertise in financial management and investment supervision.

- Excellent organisational, analytical and interpersonal skills.

- Advanced knowledge of IT tools for pension management and reporting.

- Managerial competences.

- Languages: Italian, English – German and French are assets

## Working Relationships

The Administration of the Foundation is composed of a small team, where collaboration between the Pension Fund Manager and all other roles of the Team is essential.

The role implies frequent interactions with Board members, external auditors, actuaries, human resources office, reinsurer, investment advisory, responsible of investment mandates, relationship manager of the Custodian Bank.

## Decision-Making & Autonomy

Autonomous and structured management of all tasks, with a global overview of the entire operations of the Foundation.

Plans and organizes activities quickly, recognizing priorities, formulating solutions appropriate to the circumstances. Communicates his views to colleagues in a timely manner, seeking to promote transparency, circulation of information within the team and process efficiency.

## Working Conditions

Work in EFG Office Lugano with frequent travel to EFG offices or to service providers (Actuary, Investment Controller, cooperating financial institutions, …) in Geneva or Zurich.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sintesi del Lavoro Il Responsabile del Fondo Pensionistico è incaricato della gestione e dell'amministrazione del fondo pensionistico dell'azienda, garantendo il rispetto delle normative vigenti e la protezione degli interessi dei dipendenti delle società affiliate contro le conseguenze economiche dell'età avanzata, della morte e dell'invalidità. Coordina tutte le attività operative, finanziarie e amministrative del fondo pensionistico, in linea con i regolamenti della fondazione, le politiche e le disposizioni legali.

## Compiti e Responsabilità
- Responsabilità complessiva della gestione amministrativa, tecnico-contabile e operativa della Fondazione
- Definizione delle regolamentazioni e dei parametri attuariali sottostanti il piano al fine di raggiungere un equilibrio finanziario a lungo termine
- Gestione amministrativa e operativa del fondo pensionistico, inclusa l'iscrizione dei membri, la gestione delle contribuzioni e dei benefici
- Supervisione della redazione del Rapporto Annuale, della contabilità e della relazione attuariale alla board della fondazione e agli organismi di controllo, nonché del reporting secondo IAS 19 a EFG SA
- Coordinamento con enti esterni (consulenti attuariali, revisori, autorità di controllo) e fornitori di servizi (banche custodi, gestori di asset)
- Supervisione degli investimenti del fondo pensionistico, in conformità con le regolamentazioni di investimento e i criteri di rischio
- Supervisione e controllo dei conti annuali, delle dichiarazioni finanziarie e della documentazione richiesta dagli organismi di controllo
- Supporto alla Board della Fondazione nella definizione della strategia del fondo pensionistico, garantendo la stabilità finanziaria della fondazione
- Gestione delle comunicazioni ai membri, inclusa l'informazione sui benefici e le modifiche normative
- Monitoraggio dello sviluppo normativo nel campo delle pensioni e aggiornamento delle procedure interne
- Supervisione del sistema di controllo interno
- Garanzia di una costante collaborazione con il dipartimento risorse umane di EFG SA, concordando procedure, identificando sinergie e analizzando insieme temi comuni
- Preparazione e coordinamento delle riunioni della board della fondazione e del comitato di investimento, redigendo le relative minute
- Fornire attivamente consulenza pensionistica a tutti i beneficiari (dipendenti attivi e pensionati)

## Requisiti e Qualifiche
- Laurea in Economia, Finanza, Scienze Attuariali o discipline correlate
- Esperienza comprovata nella gestione di fondi pensionistici, fondi di previdenza o istituzioni simili
- Conoscenza solida della legislazione pensionistica (es. LOB in Svizzera o legislazione locale equivalente)
- Competenza nella gestione finanziaria e supervisione degli investimenti
- Eccellenti capacità organizzative, analitiche e interpersonali
- Conoscenza avanzata degli strumenti informatici per la gestione e il reporting pensionistico
- Competenze manageriali
- Lingue: Italiano, Inglese – Tedesco e Francese sono un vantaggio

## Relazioni Lavorative L'amministrazione della Fondazione è composta da un piccolo team, dove la collaborazione tra il Responsabile del Fondo Pensionistico e tutti gli altri ruoli del Team è essenziale. Il ruolo implica interazioni frequenti con i membri della Board, revisori esterni, attuari, ufficio risorse umane, riassicuratore, consulente di investimento, responsabile degli incarichi di investimento, manager di relazione della banca custode.

## Decisioni e Autonomia Gestione autonoma e strutturata di tutte le attività, con una visione globale di tutte le operazioni della Fondazione. Pianifica e organizza rapidamente le attività, riconoscendo le priorità, formulando soluzioni appropriate alle circostanze. Comunica tempestivamente le proprie opinioni ai colleghi, promuovendo trasparenza, circolazione delle informazioni all'interno del team e efficienza dei processi.

## Condizioni di Lavoro Lavoro in ufficio EFG a Lugano con frequenti viaggi verso gli uffici EFG o i fornitori di servizi (Attuario, Controllore degli Investimenti, istituti finanziari collaborativi, ...) a Ginevra o Zurigo.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Stellenüberblick Der Stiftungsleiter ist verantwortlich für die Verwaltung und Administration des Unternehmenspensionsfonds, wobei die Einhaltung der geltenden Vorschriften und der Schutz der Interessen der Mitarbeiter der verbundenen Unternehmen vor den wirtschaftlichen Folgen des hohen Alters, des Todes und der Behinderung gewährleistet werden. Er/sie koordiniert alle operativen, finanziellen und administrativen Aktivitäten des Pensionsfonds gemäß den Stiftungsregelungen, Politiken und gesetzlichen Bestimmungen.

## Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten
- Gesamte Verantwortung für die administrative Verwaltung, technisch-kontabile und geschäftliche Aktivitäten der Stiftung
- Definition der finanziellen und versicherungsmathematischen Regelungen und Parameter, die den Plan unterliegen, um eine langfristige finanzielle Gleichgewicht zu erreichen
- Administrative und operative Verwaltung des Pensionsfonds, einschließlich der Registrierung der Mitglieder, der Verwaltung von Beiträgen und Leistungen
- Überwachung der Erstellung des Jahresberichts, der Buchhaltung und der versicherungsmathematischen Berichte an den Stiftungsrat und die Aufsichtsbehörden sowie der Berichte gemäß IAS 19 an EFG SA
- Koordination mit externen Stellen (versicherungsmathematische Berater, Prüfer, Aufsichtsbehörden) und Dienstleistern (Treuhänderbanken, Vermögensverwalter)
- Überwachung der Pensionsfonds-Investitionen gemäß den Investitionsregelungen und Risikokriterien
- Überwachung und Kontrolle der Jahresrechnungen, Finanzberichte und Dokumentationen, die von den Aufsichtsbehörden gefordert werden
- Unterstützung des Stiftungsrates bei der Definition der Strategie des Pensionsfonds, Sicherstellung der finanziellen Stabilität der Stiftung
- Verwaltung der Kommunikation mit den Mitgliedern, einschließlich Informationen zu Leistungen und regulatorischen Änderungen
- Überwachung der regulatorischen Entwicklungen im Bereich der Pensionsvorsorge und Aktualisierung der internen Verfahren
- Überwachung des internen Kontrollsystems
- Sicherstellung der konstanten Zusammenarbeit mit dem Personalabteilung von EFG SA, Vereinbarung von Verfahren, Identifizierung von Synergien und gemeinsame Analyse von gemeinsamen Themen
- Vorbereitung und Koordination der Sitzungen des Stiftungsrats und des Investmentkomitees, Erstellung der entsprechenden Protokolle
- Aktive Beratung in Sachen Pensionsvorsorge für alle Versicherten (aktive Mitarbeiter und Pensionäre)

## Anforderungen und Qualifikationen
- Abschluss in Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Finanzwissenschaften, Versicherungsmathematik oder verwandten Disziplinen
- Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Verwaltung von Pensionsfonds, Vorsorgefonds oder ähnlichen Institutionen
- Solides Wissen über Pensionsgesetzgebung (z. B. LOB in der Schweiz oder vergleichbare lokale Gesetzgebung)
- Expertise in der Finanzverwaltung und Überwachung von Investitionen
- Ausgezeichnete organisatorische, analytische und zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten
- Fortgeschrittene Kenntnisse in IT-Tools für Pensionsverwaltung und Berichterstattung
- Führungskompetenzen
- Sprachen: Italienisch, Englisch – Deutsch und Französisch sind ein Vorteil

## Arbeitsbeziehungen Die Verwaltung der Stiftung besteht aus einem kleinen Team, in dem die Zusammenarbeit zwischen dem Stiftungsleiter und allen anderen Rollen des Teams entscheidend ist. Die Rolle beinhaltet häufige Interaktionen mit Mitgliedern des Vorstands, externen Prüfern, Versicherungsmathematikern, Personalabteilung, Rückversicherer, Investmentberater, Verantwortlichen für Investmentaufträge, Relationship Manager der Treuhänderbank.

## Entscheidungsfindung & Autonomie Autonomes und strukturiertes Management aller Aufgaben mit einem globalen Überblick über alle Operationen der Stiftung. Planung und Organisation der Aktivitäten rasch, Prioritäten erkennen, Lösungen entsprechend der Umstände formulieren. Ansichten gegenüber Kolleginnen und Kollegen rechtzeitig kommunizieren, um Transparenz, Informationsfluss innerhalb des Teams und Prozess-effizienz zu fördern.

## Arbeitsbedingungen Arbeiten im EFG-Büro in Lugano mit häufigen Reisen zu EFG-Büros oder Dienstleistern (Versicherungsmathematiker, Investmentcontroller, kooperierende Finanzinstitute, ...) in Genf oder Zürich.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Résumé du poste Le Gestionnaire du Fonds de Pension est chargé de la gestion et de l'administration du fonds de pension de l'entreprise, en veillant à respecter les réglementations en vigueur et à protéger les intérêts des employés des sociétés affiliées contre les conséquences économiques de la vieillesse, du décès et de l'incapacité. Il/elle coordonne toutes les activités opérationnelles, financières et administratives du fonds de pension, conformément aux règlements de la fondation, aux politiques et aux dispositions légales.

## Tâches et Responsabilités
- Responsabilité globale de la gestion administrative, technique-comptable et opérationnelle de la Fondation
- Définition des règlements et paramètres actuariels sous-jacents au plan afin d'atteindre un équilibre financier à long terme
- Gestion administrative et opérationnelle du fonds de pension, y compris l'inscription des membres, la gestion des cotisations et des prestations
- Supervision de l'établissement du Rapport Annuel, de la comptabilité et du reporting actuariel au conseil de la fondation et aux organismes de contrôle, ainsi que du reporting selon IAS 19 vers EFG SA
- Coordination avec les organismes externes (conseillers actuariels, auditeurs, autorités de contrôle) et les prestataires de services (banques dépositaires, gestionnaires d'actifs)
- Supervision des investissements du fonds de pension, conformément aux règlements d'investissement et critères de risque
- Supervision et contrôle des comptes annuels, états financiers et documents requis par les organismes de contrôle
- Soutien au Conseil de la Fondation dans la définition de la stratégie du fonds de pension, en garantissant la stabilité financière de la fondation
- Gestion des communications aux membres, y compris les informations sur les prestations et les changements réglementaires
- Suivi des développements réglementaires dans le domaine des retraites et mise à jour des procédures internes
- Supervision du système de contrôle interne
- Garantir une collaboration constante avec le service des ressources humaines d'EFG SA, en définissant des procédures, en identifiant des synergies et en analysant conjointement des sujets communs
- Préparation et coordination des réunions du conseil de la fondation et du comité d'investissement, en rédigeant les procès-verbaux correspondants
- Fournir activement des conseils en matière de retraite à tous les assurés (employés actifs et retraités)

## Exigences et Qualifications
- Diplôme en Économie, Finance, Science Actuarielle ou disciplines connexes
- Expérience prouvée dans la gestion de fonds de pension, de fonds de prévoyance ou d'institutions similaires
- Bonnes connaissances de la législation sur les retraites (ex. LOB en Suisse ou législation locale équivalente)
- Expertise en gestion financière et supervision des investissements
- Excellentes compétences organisationnelles, analytiques et interpersonnelles
- Connaissances avancées des outils informatiques pour la gestion et le reporting des retraites
- Compétences managériales
- Langues : Italien, Anglais – Allemand et Français sont un atout

## Relations de Travail L'administration de la Fondation est composée d'une petite équipe, où la collaboration entre le Gestionnaire du Fonds de Pension et tous les autres rôles de l'équipe est essentielle. Le poste implique des interactions fréquentes avec les membres du Conseil, auditeurs externes, actuaires, service des ressources humaines, réassureur, conseiller en investissement, responsable des mandats d'investissement, manager de relation de la banque dépositaire.

## Prise de Décision & Autonomie Gestion autonome et structurée de toutes les tâches, avec une vue d'ensemble globale de toutes les opérations de la Fondation. Planification et organisation rapides des activités, reconnaissance des priorités, formulation de solutions adaptées aux circonstances. Communication en temps voulu des points de vue aux collègues, en visant à promouvoir la transparence, le flux d'informations au sein de l'équipe et l'efficacité des processus.

## Conditions de Travail Travail au bureau EFG à Lugano avec des déplacements fréquents vers les bureaux EFG ou les prestataires de services (Actuaire, Contrôleur des Investissements, institutions financières collaboratives, ...) à Genève ou Zurich.

jobs.title: Global Regulatory Reporting Specialist
jobs.description:
General Info
· Department: Finance – Regulatory Reporting
· Work time Percentage: 100%
· Location: Geneva

Our Company
EFG International is a global private banking group, offering private banking and asset management services. We serve clients in over 40 locations worldwide. EFG International offers a stimulating and dynamic work environment and strives to be an employer of choice.

Our Purpose and Mission
Empowering entrepreneurial minds to create value – today and for the future.

Job Description

As Global Regulatory Reporting Specialist, you will lead the end‑to‑end production, integrity and continuous enhancement of prudential regulatory returns for EFG’s Swiss entity and its international network of booking centres. Operating within the CFO function, you will act as a senior subject‑matter expert on capital adequacy, liquidity and statistical reporting, ensuring complete, accurate and timely submissions across multiple jurisdictions.

You will work autonomously across the full regulatory reporting lifecycle, from interpretation of complex rules and data requirements, through design of robust processes and controls, to delivery of high‑quality reports to regulators. In close collaboration with Finance, Risk, Treasury, IT and local CFO teams, you will shape sustainable reporting solutions, drive automation and support the bank’s regulatory change agenda, with decisions that influence EFG’s regulatory risk profile over the medium term.

Key Responsibilities

Regulatory Reporting Production and Ownership

- Lead the end‑to‑end production of Swiss and international prudential regulatory returns (e.g. capital adequacy, LCR, NSFR, large exposures, COREP and statistical reports), ensuring accuracy, completeness and timely submission across all in‑scope entities.

- Define and manage the operational reporting calendar, including resource planning and sequencing of monthly, quarterly and annual submissions across different time zones.

- Establish, document and maintain audit‑ready reporting processes, controls and reconciliations that support operational excellence and a high level of data integrity.

Regulatory Interpretation and Complex Analysis

- Interpret and apply relevant regulatory frameworks (e.g. Basel III, FINMA Ordinances and Circulars, CRR/CRD and other European, Asian and offshore prudential regimes) to define clear reporting requirements and data rules.

- Perform advanced analyses on capital and liquidity metrics, explaining key movements, trends and sensitivities to senior stakeholders in Finance, Risk and Treasury.

- Design pragmatic solutions for non‑standard transactions and data gaps, balancing regulatory expectations, operational feasibility and long‑term sustainability.

Change Management, Projects and Automation

- Monitor regulatory developments across all jurisdictions in scope and assess their impact on reporting architecture, data models and processes.

- Advise Finance, Risk, Treasury and Front Office on the regulatory implications of new products, transactions and structural balance sheet changes.

- Represent Regulatory Reporting in cross‑functional working groups, ensuring regulatory requirements are embedded in upstream processes and systems.

- Build strong relationships with local CFOs and finance teams across the Group, promoting consistent standards and fostering a culture of accountability for data quality.

Leadership, Coaching and Best Practice

- Provide expert guidance, coaching and review to junior team members, promoting best practice in regulatory interpretation, documentation and stakeholder communication.

- Contribute to the continuous improvement of the Regulatory Reporting function by sharing knowledge, standardising methodologies and supporting the development of internal expertise.

Requirements and Qualifications

Education and Professional Background

- University degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration or a related quantitative discipline.

- Postgraduate qualification and/or professional certification (e.g. CPA, CFA, FRM or equivalent) is a strong asset.

- Typically 8–12 years of experience in private banking or financial services, with a focus on Regulatory Reporting, Financial Accounting, Risk or Audit.

- Proven experience working with Swiss prudential regulation and exposure to at least one other international regime (e.g. European, Asian or offshore centres).

Technical and Functional Expertise

- Deep understanding of prudential regulatory frameworks relevant to EFG (e.g. Basel III, FINMA Ordinances and Circulars, CRR/CRD‑based European frameworks, and Basel‑derived regimes in Asia and offshore centres).

- Strong grasp of how regulatory requirements translate into data structures, systems architecture and reporting processes.

- Solid knowledge of related functions (Risk, Treasury, Accounting, Private Banking) and their interdependencies, with the ability to integrate perspectives when designing reporting solutions.

- High proficiency in Excel and regulatory reporting tools; experience working with large data sets and complex reconciliations.

- Familiarity with data querying and visualisation tools is an advantage, as is experience in building analytical and control dashboards.

Languages

- English: full professional proficiency (spoken and written), as the main working language across the Group.

- French: fluency is a strong asset for interaction with local stakeholders in Geneva and with French‑regulated entities; other languages are an advantage.

Behavioural Skills and Working Style

- Strong sense of accountability, with the ability to work autonomously on complex deliverables and take ownership of the integrity and timeliness of regulatory submissions.

- Proactive, solution‑oriented mindset, able to prioritise effectively and manage multiple reporting cycles and projects under tight deadlines.

- Excellent communication skills, capable of conveying complex regulatory and technical topics clearly to both specialist and non‑specialist audiences.

- Collaborative team player with strong interpersonal skills, able to influence and negotiate with stakeholders across cultures, functions and time zones.

- Future‑oriented and comfortable with change, with a keen interest in regulatory developments, digitalisation and process automation.

Our Values
· Accountability: Taking ownership for tasks and challenges, as well as seeking continuous improvement
· Hands-on: Being proactive to rapidly deliver high-quality results
· Passionate: Being committed and striving for excellence
· Solution-driven: Focusing on client outcomes and treating clients fairly with a risk-aware mindset
· Partnership-oriented: Promoting collaboration and teamwork. Working together with an entrepreneurial spirit.

La nostra azienda
EFG International è un gruppo bancario privato globale, che offre servizi di private banking e asset management. Serviamo clienti in oltre 40 sedi in tutto il mondo. EFG International offre un ambiente di lavoro stimolante e dinamico e si sforza di essere un datore di lavoro di scelta.

Il nostro scopo e missione
Incoraggiare le menti imprenditoriali a creare valore – oggi e per il futuro.

Descrizione del lavoro

In qualità di Global Regulatory Reporting Specialist, guiderai la produzione end-to-end, l’integrità e il continuo miglioramento dei rendimenti normativi prudenziali per l’entità svizzera di EFG e la sua rete internazionale di centri di prenotazione. Operando all'interno della funzione CFO, si agirà come un esperto soggetto-materia senior sull'adeguatezza dei capitali, la liquidità e il reporting statistico, garantendo presentazioni complete, accurate e tempestive su più giurisdizioni.

Potrai lavorare autonomamente attraverso il ciclo di vita di reportistica completo, dall'interpretazione di regole complesse e requisiti di dati, attraverso la progettazione di processi e controlli robusti, alla consegna di report di alta qualità ai regolatori. In stretta collaborazione con i team Finance, Risk, Treasury, IT e CFO locali, formerai soluzioni di reporting sostenibili, guiderai l’automazione e supporterai l’agenda dei cambiamenti normativi della banca, con decisioni che influenzano il profilo dei rischi normativi di EFG a medio termine.

Principali responsabilità

Regolamentazione Reporting Produzione e Proprietà

- Condurre la produzione end-to-end dei rendimenti normativi prudenziali svizzeri e internazionali (ad esempio l'adeguatezza dei capitali, LCR, NSFR, grandi esposizioni, COREP e rapporti statistici), garantendo accuratezza, completezza e tempestiva presentazione in tutte le entità in-scope.

- Definire e gestire il calendario di reporting operativo, compresa la pianificazione delle risorse e il sequenziamento delle presentazioni mensili, trimestrali e annuali in diversi fusi orari.

- Stabilire, documentare e mantenere i processi di reportistica, i controlli e le conciliazioni che supportano l'eccellenza operativa e un alto livello di integrità dei dati.

Interpretazione regolamentare e analisi complessa

- Interpretare ed applicare i pertinenti quadri normativi (ad esempio Basilea III, FINMA Ordinances and Circulars, CRR/CRD e altri regimi prudenziali europei, asiatici e offshore) per definire chiari requisiti di report e regole di dati.

- Eseguire analisi avanzate sulle metriche di capitale e liquidità, spiegando i movimenti chiave, le tendenze e le sensibilità agli stakeholder senior in Finanza, Rischio e Tesoro.

- Progettare soluzioni pragmatiche per operazioni non standard e lacune di dati, bilanciare le aspettative normative, fattibilità operativa e sostenibilità a lungo termine.

Gestione dei cambiamenti, progetti e automazione

- Monitorare gli sviluppi normativi in tutte le giurisdizioni di portata e valutare il loro impatto sull'architettura di reportistica, modelli e processi dati.

- Atto come proprietario aziendale o lead funzionale per le iniziative di cambiamento normativo e IT, definendo i requisiti aziendali, i casi di test e i criteri di accettazione per nuovi o potenziati strumenti di reportistica.

- Guidare l'automazione e le iniziative di miglioramento del processo (ad esempio miglioramenti ai sistemi di reporting e dashboard di controllo) per aumentare l'efficienza, ridurre lo sforzo manuale e rafforzare il controllo.

Consulente, Gestione e Collaborazione Stakeholder

- Consigli finanziari, rischi, tesoreria e front office sulle implicazioni normative di nuovi prodotti, transazioni e cambi del bilancio strutturale.

- Rappresentare la Represental Regulatory Reporting in gruppi di lavoro interfunzionali, assicurando che i requisiti normativi siano incorporati in processi e sistemi a monte.

- Costruire forti relazioni con i CFO locali e i team di finanza in tutto il Gruppo, promuovendo standard coerenti e promuovendo una cultura di responsabilità per la qualità dei dati.

Leadership, coaching e best practice

- Fornire una guida esperta, coaching e revisione ai membri del team junior, promuovendo la migliore pratica nell'interpretazione normativa, nella documentazione e nella comunicazione degli stakeholder.

- Contribuire al miglioramento continuo della funzione di Reporting regolamentare condividendo conoscenze, standardizzando metodologie e supportando lo sviluppo di competenze interne.

Requisiti e qualifiche

Istruzione e sfondo professionale

- Laurea in finanza, contabilità, economia, economia aziendale o una disciplina quantitativa relativa.

- La qualificazione post-laurea e/o la certificazione professionale (ad esempio CPA, CFA, FRM o equivalente) è un bene forte.

- Tipicamente 8–12 anni di esperienza nei servizi bancari privati o finanziari, con un focus sul reporting regolamentare, contabilità finanziaria, rischio o audit.

- Provata esperienza di lavoro con la regolamentazione prudenziale svizzera e l'esposizione ad almeno un altro regime internazionale (ad esempio centri europei, asiatici o offshore).

Esperienza tecnica e funzionale

- Comprensione profonda dei quadri normativi prudenziali relativi all'EFG (ad esempio Basilea III, Ordinanze FINMA e Circolari, Quadri Europei basati su CRR/CRD e Registri derivati da Basilea in Asia e nei centri offshore).

- Forte comprensione di come i requisiti normativi si traducono in strutture di dati, architetture di sistemi e processi di reporting.

- Conoscenza solida delle funzioni correlate (Rischio, Tesoro, Contabilità, Private Banking) e le loro interdipendenze, con la capacità di integrare le prospettive nella progettazione di soluzioni di reporting.

- Alta competenza in Excel e strumenti di reporting normativi; esperienza di lavoro con grandi set di dati e conciliazioni complesse.

- La familiarità con gli strumenti di ricerca e visualizzazione dei dati è un vantaggio, così come l'esperienza nella costruzione di dashboard analitiche e di controllo.

Lingue

- Inglese: piena competenza professionale (parlato e scritto), come la lingua di lavoro principale in tutto il Gruppo.

- Francese: la fluenza è un bene forte per l'interazione con gli stakeholder locali a Ginevra e con le entità regolamentate francesi; altre lingue sono un vantaggio.

Abilità comportamentali e stile di lavoro

- Forte senso di responsabilità, con la capacità di lavorare autonomamente sui materiali di consegna complessi e prendere la proprietà dell'integrità e della tempestività delle sottomissioni normative.

- Mindset proattivo e orientato alla soluzione, in grado di priorizzare in modo efficace e gestire più cicli di report e progetti in tempi brevi.

- Eccellente capacità di comunicazione, in grado di trasmettere argomenti normativi e tecnici complessi chiaramente sia al pubblico specializzato che non specializzato.

- Giocatore di squadra collaborativo con forti competenze interpersonali, in grado di influenzare e negoziare con gli stakeholder attraverso culture, funzioni e fusi orari.

- Il futuro è orientato e confortevole con il cambiamento, con un forte interesse per gli sviluppi normativi, la digitalizzazione e l'automazione dei processi.

I nostri valori
· Responsabilità: Prendere la proprietà per le attività e le sfide, nonché cercare un miglioramento continuo
· Hands-on: essere proattivi per fornire rapidamente risultati di alta qualità
· Passionato: Impegnarsi e lottare per l'eccellenza
· Soluzione-driven: Focusing sui risultati del cliente e il trattamento dei clienti abbastanza con una mentalità di rischio-consapevole
· Partnership-oriented: promuovere la collaborazione e il lavoro di squadra. Lavorare insieme a uno spirito imprenditoriale.

Assicurarsi di allegare una lettera di copertura al vostro CV durante la compilazione dell'applicazione.

Unser Unternehmen
EFG International ist eine globale Private Banking Gruppe, die Private Banking und Asset Management Services anbietet. Wir bedienen Kunden an über 40 Standorten weltweit. EFG International bietet ein anregendes und dynamisches Arbeitsumfeld und ist bestrebt, ein Arbeitgeber der Wahl zu sein.

Unser Ziel und unsere Mission
Unternehmergeist befähigen, Werte zu schaffen – heute und für die Zukunft.

Stellenbeschreibung

Als Global Regulatory Reporting Specialist leiten Sie die End-to-End-Produktion, Integrität und kontinuierliche Verbesserung der aufsichtsrechtlichen Renditen für das Schweizer Unternehmen von EFG und sein internationales Netzwerk von Buchungszentren. Im Rahmen der CFO-Funktion fungieren Sie als leitender Fachexperte für Kapitaladäquanz, Liquidität und statistische Berichterstattung und gewährleisten vollständige, genaue und zeitnahe Einreichungen in mehreren Ländern.

Sie arbeiten autonom über den gesamten Lebenszyklus der regulatorischen Berichterstattung hinweg, von der Interpretation komplexer Regeln und Datenanforderungen über die Gestaltung robuster Prozesse und Kontrollen bis hin zur Bereitstellung hochwertiger Berichte an die Aufsichtsbehörden. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Finance, Risk, Treasury, IT und lokalen CFO-Teams gestalten Sie nachhaltige Reporting-Lösungen, treiben die Automatisierung voran und unterstützen die regulatorische Veränderungsagenda der Bank mit Entscheidungen, die das regulatorische Risikoprofil der EFG mittelfristig beeinflussen.

Hauptzuständigkeiten

Regulatory Reporting Produktion und Eigentum

- Führen Sie die End-to-End-Erstellung von schweizerischen und internationalen aufsichtsrechtlichen Renditen (z. B. Kapitaladäquanz, LCR, NSFR, Großkredite, COREP und statistische Berichte) an, um Genauigkeit, Vollständigkeit und fristgerechte Vorlage bei allen Unternehmen zu gewährleisten.

- Definieren und verwalten Sie den operativen Berichtskalender, einschließlich Ressourcenplanung und Sequenzierung von monatlichen, vierteljährlichen und jährlichen Einreichungen in verschiedenen Zeitzonen.

- Erstellung, Dokumentation und Aufrechterhaltung auditbereiter Reportingprozesse, Kontrollen und Abgleiche, die operative Exzellenz und ein hohes Maß an Datenintegrität unterstützen.

Regulatorische Interpretation und komplexe Analyse

- Interpretation und Anwendung einschlägiger Regulierungsrahmen (z. B. Basel III, FINMA-Verordnungen und -Rundschreiben, CRR/CRD und andere europäische, asiatische und Offshore-Aufsichtsregelungen), um klare Berichtspflichten und Datenregeln festzulegen.

- Führen Sie fortgeschrittene Analysen zu Kapital- und Liquiditätskennzahlen durch und erläutern Sie wichtige Bewegungen, Trends und Empfindlichkeiten für hochrangige Stakeholder in den Bereichen Finanzen, Risiko und Treasury.

- Konzeption pragmatischer Lösungen für nicht standardisierte Transaktionen und Datenlücken, Abwägung regulatorischer Erwartungen, operativer Machbarkeit und langfristiger Nachhaltigkeit.

Change Management, Projekte und Automatisierung

- Überwachen Sie die regulatorischen Entwicklungen in allen Ländern und bewerten Sie deren Auswirkungen auf die Berichtsarchitektur, Datenmodelle und -prozesse.

- Handeln Sie als Unternehmer oder funktioneller Leiter für regulatorische und IT-Änderungsinitiativen und definieren Sie Geschäftsanforderungen, Testfälle und Akzeptanzkriterien für neue oder erweiterte Berichtstools.

- Automatisierungs- und Prozessverbesserungsinitiativen vorantreiben (z. B. Erweiterungen von Reporting-Systemen und Steuerungs-Dashboards), um die Effizienz zu erhöhen, den manuellen Aufwand zu reduzieren und die Steuerung zu stärken.

Beratung, Stakeholder Management und Zusammenarbeit

- Beratung von Finance, Risk, Treasury und Front Office zu den regulatorischen Auswirkungen neuer Produkte, Transaktionen und struktureller Bilanzänderungen.

- Repräsentieren Sie die regulatorische Berichterstattung in funktionsübergreifenden Arbeitsgruppen und stellen Sie sicher, dass die regulatorischen Anforderungen in vorgelagerte Prozesse und Systeme eingebettet sind.

- Bauen Sie starke Beziehungen zu lokalen CFOs und Finanzteams in der gesamten Gruppe auf, fördern Sie einheitliche Standards und fördern Sie eine Kultur der Rechenschaftspflicht für die Datenqualität.

Führung, Coaching und Best Practice

- Bereitstellung von fachkundiger Beratung, Coaching und Überprüfung für Nachwuchsteammitglieder, Förderung von Best Practices in der regulatorischen Interpretation, Dokumentation und Stakeholder-Kommunikation.

- Beitrag zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der Funktion „Regulative Reporting durch Wissensaustausch, Standardisierung von Methoden und Unterstützung der Entwicklung interner Expertise.

Anforderungen und Qualifikationen

Bildung und beruflicher Hintergrund

- Universitätsabschluss in Finanzen, Rechnungswesen, Wirtschaft, Betriebswirtschaft oder einer verwandten quantitativen Disziplin.

- Postgraduierten-Qualifikation und / oder professionelle Zertifizierung (z. B. CPA, CFA, FRM oder gleichwertig) ist ein starker Vermögenswert.

- In der Regel 8-12 Jahre Erfahrung im Private Banking oder Finanzdienstleistungen, mit einem Schwerpunkt auf Regulatory Reporting, Financial Accounting, Risiko oder Audit.

- Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit Schweizer Aufsichtsvorschriften und der Exposition gegenüber mindestens einem anderen internationalen System (z. B. europäischen, asiatischen oder Offshore-Zentren).

Technische und funktionale Expertise

- Tiefes Verständnis der für die EFG relevanten aufsichtsrechtlichen Rahmenbedingungen (z. B. Basel III, FINMA-Verordnungen und Rundschreiben, CRR/CRD-basierte europäische Rahmenbedingungen und Basel-abgeleitete Regelungen in Asien und Offshore-Zentren).

- Starkes Verständnis dafür, wie regulatorische Anforderungen in Datenstrukturen, Systemarchitektur und Berichtsprozesse umgesetzt werden.

- Fundiertes Wissen über verwandte Funktionen (Risk, Treasury, Accounting, Private Banking) und ihre Interdependenzen, mit der Fähigkeit, Perspektiven bei der Gestaltung von Berichtslösungen zu integrieren.

- Hohe Kenntnisse in Excel und regulatorischen Reporting-Tools; Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit großen Datensätzen und komplexen Abgleichen.

- Die Vertrautheit mit Datenabfrage- und Visualisierungstools ist von Vorteil, ebenso wie die Erfahrung beim Erstellen von Analyse- und Steuerungs-Dashboards.

Sprachen

- Englisch: volle fachliche Kenntnisse (gesprochen und geschrieben), als Hauptarbeitssprache in der gesamten Gruppe.

- Französisch: fließend ist ein starker Aktivposten für die Interaktion mit lokalen Stakeholdern in Genf und mit französisch regulierten Unternehmen; andere Sprachen sind von Vorteil.

Verhaltenskompetenzen und Arbeitsstil

- Starkes Verantwortungsbewusstsein mit der Fähigkeit, autonom an komplexen Ergebnissen zu arbeiten und die Integrität und Aktualität von regulatorischen Einreichungen zu übernehmen.

- Proaktives, lösungsorientiertes Mindset, das in der Lage ist, mehrere Berichtszyklen und Projekte unter engen Fristen effektiv zu priorisieren und zu verwalten.

- Hervorragende Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, die komplexe regulatorische und technische Themen sowohl dem Fachpublikum als auch dem Fachpublikum klar vermitteln können.

- Teamplayer mit starken zwischenmenschlichen Fähigkeiten, die in der Lage sind, Interessengruppen über Kulturen, Funktionen und Zeitzonen hinweg zu beeinflussen und mit ihnen zu verhandeln.

- Zukunftsorientiert und im Wandel behaglich, mit großem Interesse an regulatorischen Entwicklungen, Digitalisierung und Prozessautomatisierung.

Unsere Werte
· Verantwortlichkeit: Übernahme von Verantwortung für Aufgaben und Herausforderungen sowie Suche nach kontinuierlicher Verbesserung
Hands-on: Proaktiv sein, um schnell qualitativ hochwertige Ergebnisse zu liefern

Autoriser les esprits entrepreneurs à créer de la valeur – aujourd'hui et pour l'avenir.

Description de l'emploi

En tant que Global Regulatory Reporting Specialist, vous dirigerez la production de bout en bout, l'intégrité et l'amélioration continue des rendements réglementaires prudentiels pour l'entité suisse EFG et son réseau international de centres de réservation. Dans le cadre de la fonction du DPF, vous agirez à titre d'expert principal en matière d'adéquation des fonds propres, de liquidité et de rapports statistiques, en veillant à ce que les présentations soient complètes, exactes et opportunes dans plusieurs administrations.

Vous travaillerez de manière autonome tout au long du cycle de vie des rapports réglementaires, depuis l'interprétation de règles complexes et des exigences en matière de données, en passant par la conception de processus et de contrôles robustes, jusqu'à la présentation de rapports de haute qualité aux organismes de réglementation. En étroite collaboration avec les équipes Finance, Risque, Trésorerie, IT et CFO locales, vous façonnerez des solutions de reporting durables, stimulerez l'automatisation et soutenirez le programme de changement réglementaire de la banque, avec des décisions qui influencent le profil de risque réglementaire de l'EFG à moyen terme.

Principales responsabilités

Rapports réglementaires Production et propriété

- Diriger la production de bout en bout de rapports réglementaires prudentiels suisses et internationaux (p. ex., suffisance du capital, LCR, NSFR, grands risques, COREP et rapports statistiques), assurer l'exactitude, l'exhaustivité et la soumission en temps opportun de toutes les entités du champ d'application.

- Définir et gérer le calendrier des rapports opérationnels, y compris la planification des ressources et le séquençage des présentations mensuelles, trimestrielles et annuelles dans différents fuseaux horaires.

- Établir, documenter et maintenir des processus de rapport, des contrôles et des rapprochements prêts à l'audit qui appuient l'excellence opérationnelle et un haut niveau d'intégrité des données.

Interprétation réglementaire et analyse complexe

- Interpréter et appliquer les cadres réglementaires pertinents (par exemple Bâle III, Ordonnances et circulaires FINMA, CRR/CRD et autres régimes prudentiels européens, asiatiques et offshore) pour définir des exigences claires en matière de déclaration et des règles en matière de données.

- Effectuer des analyses poussées sur les paramètres du capital et de la liquidité, en expliquant les principaux mouvements, tendances et sensibilités aux principaux intervenants en matière de finances, de risques et de trésorerie.

- Concevoir des solutions pragmatiques pour les transactions non standard et les lacunes dans les données, équilibrer les attentes réglementaires, la faisabilité opérationnelle et la durabilité à long terme.

Gestion du changement, projets et automatisation

- Surveiller l'évolution de la réglementation dans toutes les administrations et évaluer leur incidence sur l'architecture de rapport, les modèles de données et les processus.

- Agir en tant que propriétaire d'entreprise ou chef de file fonctionnel pour les initiatives de changement de réglementation et de TI, en définissant les exigences opérationnelles, les cas d'essai et les critères d'acceptation pour les nouveaux outils de déclaration ou les outils améliorés.

- Diriger les initiatives d'automatisation et d'amélioration des processus (p. ex. améliorations des systèmes de rapport et des tableaux de bord de contrôle) pour accroître l'efficacité, réduire l'effort manuel et renforcer le contrôle.

Conseils, gestion des intervenants et collaboration

- Conseiller les Finances, les Risques, le Trésor et le Front Office sur les implications réglementaires des nouveaux produits, des transactions et des changements au bilan structurel.

- Représenter les rapports réglementaires dans les groupes de travail interfonctionnels, en veillant à ce que les exigences réglementaires soient intégrées aux processus et aux systèmes en amont.

- Établir des relations solides avec les OFC et les équipes financières locales dans l'ensemble du Groupe, en favorisant des normes cohérentes et en favorisant une culture de reddition de comptes pour la qualité des données.

Leadership, coaching et meilleure pratique

- Fournir une orientation, un encadrement et un examen spécialisés aux membres de l'équipe junior, en favorisant les meilleures pratiques en matière d'interprétation réglementaire, de documentation et de communication avec les intervenants.

- Contribuer à l'amélioration continue de la fonction Rapports réglementaires en partageant les connaissances, en standardisant les méthodologies et en appuyant le développement de l'expertise interne.

Exigences et qualifications

Éducation et formation professionnelles

- Diplôme universitaire en finance, comptabilité, économie, administration des affaires ou une discipline quantitative connexe.

- La qualification postdoctorale et/ou la certification professionnelle (p. ex. CPA, FCA, FRM ou équivalent) est un atout important.

- Habituellement, de 8 à 12 ans d'expérience dans les services bancaires ou financiers privés, l'accent étant mis sur les rapports réglementaires, la comptabilité financière, le risque ou la vérification.

- Expérience éprouvée en matière de réglementation prudentielle suisse et d'exposition à au moins un autre régime international (par exemple, les centres européens, asiatiques ou offshore).

Expertise technique et fonctionnelle

- Compréhension approfondie des cadres réglementaires prudentiels pertinents pour l'EFG (par exemple Bâle III, ordonnances et circulaires FINMA, cadres européens fondés sur le CRR/CRD et régimes dérivés de Bâle en Asie et dans les centres offshore).

- Une bonne compréhension de la façon dont les exigences réglementaires se traduisent par des structures de données, une architecture de systèmes et des processus de rapport.

- Connaissance approfondie des fonctions connexes (risque, Trésorerie, Comptabilité, Private Banking) et de leurs interdépendances, avec la capacité d'intégrer des perspectives lors de la conception de solutions de reporting.

- Haute compétence en Excel et en outils de rapports réglementaires; expérience de travail avec de grands ensembles de données et rapprochements complexes.

- La connaissance des outils d'interrogation et de visualisation des données est un avantage, tout comme l'expérience acquise dans la construction de tableaux de bord analytiques et de contrôle.

Langues

- Anglais : compétence professionnelle complète (parlé et écrit), comme langue de travail principale dans tout le Groupe.

- Français: la fluidité est un atout important pour l'interaction avec les acteurs locaux à Genève et avec les entités réglementées par le français; d'autres langues sont un avantage.

Compétences comportementales et style de travail

- Forte responsabilisation, capable de travailler de façon autonome sur des produits livrables complexes et de s'approprier l'intégrité et la rapidité des présentations réglementaires.

- Un état d'esprit proactif et axé sur la solution, capable de hiérarchiser efficacement et de gérer plusieurs cycles de rapports et projets dans des délais serrés.

- Excellentes compétences en communication, capables de transmettre clairement aux publics spécialisés et non spécialisés des sujets réglementaires et techniques complexes.

- Joueur d'équipe collaborative avec de solides compétences interpersonnelles, capable d'influencer et de négocier avec les intervenants à travers les cultures, les fonctions et les fuseaux horaires.

- Orientations futures et à l'aise avec le changement, avec un vif intérêt pour les développements réglementaires, la numérisation et l'automatisation des processus.

Nos valeurs
· Responsabilisation : prise en charge des tâches et des défis, et recherche d'amélioration continue
· Hands-on : être proactif pour obtenir rapidement des résultats de haute qualité
· Passionné : être engagé et viser l'excellence
· Inspiré par la solution : se concentrer sur les résultats des clients et traiter les clients avec équité en tenant compte des risques
· Objectif partenariat : promouvoir la collaboration et le travail d'équipe. Travailler ensemble avec un esprit d'entreprise.

General Info

Our Company
EFG International is a global private banking group, offering private banking and asset management services. We serve clients in over 40 locations worldwide. EFG International offers a stimulating and dynamic work environment and strives to be an employer of choice.
EFG is committed to providing an equitable and inclusive working environment that is founded on the principle of mutual respect. Joining our team means experiencing a supportive environment, where your contributions are valued and recognised. We strongly believe that the diversity of our teams gives us a competitive advantage by fostering better decision-making and greater innovation.

Our Purpose and Mission
Empowering entrepreneurial minds to create value – today and for the future.
We are a private bank, offering personalised solutions on a global scale to private and institutional clients. Our sustainable success is based on our talents and on how we partner with our clients and communities to create lasting value.

Job Description

As Global Regulatory Reporting Specialist, you will lead the end‑to‑end production, integrity and continuous enhancement of prudential regulatory returns for EFG’s Swiss entity and its international network of booking centres. Operating within the CFO function, you will act as a senior subject‑matter expert on capital adequacy, liquidity and statistical reporting, ensuring complete, accurate and timely submissions across multiple jurisdictions.

You will work autonomously across the full regulatory reporting lifecycle, from interpretation of complex rules and data requirements, through design of robust processes and controls, to delivery of high‑quality reports to regulators. In close collaboration with Finance, Risk, Treasury, IT and local CFO teams, you will shape sustainable reporting solutions, drive automation and support the bank’s regulatory change agenda, with decisions that influence EFG’s regulatory risk profile over the medium term.

Key Responsibilities

Regulatory Reporting Production and Ownership

  • Lead the end‑to‑end production of Swiss and international prudential regulatory returns (e.g. capital adequacy, LCR, NSFR, large exposures, COREP and statistical reports), ensuring accuracy, completeness and timely submission across all in‑scope entities.
  • Define and manage the operational reporting calendar, including resource planning and sequencing of monthly, quarterly and annual submissions across different time zones.
  • Establish, document and maintain audit‑ready reporting processes, controls and reconciliations that support operational excellence and a high level of data integrity.

Regulatory Interpretation and Complex Analysis

  • Interpret and apply relevant regulatory frameworks (e.g. Basel III, FINMA Ordinances and Circulars, CRR/CRD and other European, Asian and offshore prudential regimes) to define clear reporting requirements and data rules.
  • Perform advanced analyses on capital and liquidity metrics, explaining key movements, trends and sensitivities to senior stakeholders in Finance, Risk and Treasury.
  • Design pragmatic solutions for non‑standard transactions and data gaps, balancing regulatory expectations, operational feasibility and long‑term sustainability.

Change Management, Projects and Automation

  • Monitor regulatory developments across all jurisdictions in scope and assess their impact on reporting architecture, data models and processes.
  • Act as business owner or functional lead for regulatory and IT change initiatives, defining business requirements, test cases and acceptance criteria for new or enhanced reporting tools.
  • Drive automation and process improvement initiatives (e.g. enhancements to reporting systems and control dashboards) to increase efficiency, reduce manual effort and strengthen control.

Advisory, Stakeholder Management and Collaboration

  • Advise Finance, Risk, Treasury and Front Office on the regulatory implications of new products, transactions and structural balance sheet changes.
  • Represent Regulatory Reporting in cross‑functional working groups, ensuring regulatory requirements are embedded in upstream processes and systems.
  • Build strong relationships with local CFOs and finance teams across the Group, promoting consistent standards and fostering a culture of accountability for data quality.

Leadership, Coaching and Best Practice

  • Provide expert guidance, coaching and review to junior team members, promoting best practice in regulatory interpretation, documentation and stakeholder communication.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of the Regulatory Reporting function by sharing knowledge, standardising methodologies and supporting the development of internal expertise.

Requirements and Qualifications

Education and Professional Background

  • University degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration or a related quantitative discipline.
  • Postgraduate qualification and/or professional certification (e.g. CPA, CFA, FRM or equivalent) is a strong asset.
  • Typically 8–12 years of experience in private banking or financial services, with a focus on Regulatory Reporting, Financial Accounting, Risk or Audit.
  • Proven experience working with Swiss prudential regulation and exposure to at least one other international regime (e.g. European, Asian or offshore centres).

Technical and Functional Expertise

  • Deep understanding of prudential regulatory frameworks relevant to EFG (e.g. Basel III, FINMA Ordinances and Circulars, CRR/CRD‑based European frameworks, and Basel‑derived regimes in Asia and offshore centres).
  • Strong grasp of how regulatory requirements translate into data structures, systems architecture and reporting processes.
  • Solid knowledge of related functions (Risk, Treasury, Accounting, Private Banking) and their interdependencies, with the ability to integrate perspectives when designing reporting solutions.
  • High proficiency in Excel and regulatory reporting tools; experience working with large data sets and complex reconciliations.
  • Familiarity with data querying and visualisation tools is an advantage, as is experience in building analytical and control dashboards.

Languages

  • English: full professional proficiency (spoken and written), as the main working language across the Group.
  • French: fluency is a strong asset for interaction with local stakeholders in Geneva and with French‑regulated entities; other languages are an advantage.

Behavioural Skills and Working Style

  • Strong sense of accountability, with the ability to work autonomously on complex deliverables and take ownership of the integrity and timeliness of regulatory submissions.
  • Proactive, solution‑oriented mindset, able to prioritise effectively and manage multiple reporting cycles and projects under tight deadlines.
  • Excellent communication skills, capable of conveying complex regulatory and technical topics clearly to both specialist and non‑specialist audiences.
  • Collaborative team player with strong interpersonal skills, able to influence and negotiate with stakeholders across cultures, functions and time zones.
  • Future‑oriented and comfortable with change, with a keen interest in regulatory developments, digitalisation and process automation.

Our Values
· Accountability: Taking ownership for tasks and challenges, as well as seeking continuous improvement
· Hands-on: Being proactive to rapidly deliver high-quality results
· Passionate: Being committed and striving for excellence
· Solution-driven: Focusing on client outcomes and treating clients fairly with a risk-aware mindset
· Partnership-oriented: Promoting collaboration and teamwork. Working together with an entrepreneurial spirit.

Please ensure to attach a cover letter to your CV when filling the application.

Our Company

EFG International is a global private banking group, offering private banking and asset management services. We serve clients in over 40 locations worldwide. EFG International offers a stimulating and dynamic work environment and strives to be an employer of choice.

Our Purpose and Mission

Empowering entrepreneurial minds to create value – today and for the future.

Job Description

DataOps platform team mission is to ensure a reliable service level across each technological component of the EFG data platform (Databricks, Kafka, Spark, Elastic Search, Apache MQ, uServices stack).

We are building and evolving the CI/CD Platform that supports data pipeline deployments, bringing implementation expertise and working closely with project teams to get deliverables across the line.

Key team responsibilities includes, CI/CD governance of data pipelines, pipeline deployment support and certification and monitoring of platform level operations.

Main Responsibilities

As our platform and data landscape evolve, we would like to strengthen our team with a skilled CI/CD engineer specialised in data pipeline implementations.

- Expectations on data quality are constantly increasing with the need for a extremely stable service delivery. We must ensure that our delivery processes are controlled and visible to our stakeholders.

- We are particularly interested in someone comfortable driving Kafka, Spark and Databricks operations with Python

- By reinforcing our team, you will greatly contribute to the continuity and quality of our operations.

- Take operational ownership of specific data services (change management, quality insurance management, SLA, SOP)

- track and ensure the smooth operation of critical data pipelines during Asian hours, acting as the primary point of contact for critical issues in a follow-the sun support model.

- Design, implement, and optimize data pipeline in batch and streaming mode.

- Follow and apply CI/CD practice to automate and streamline deployments and integrations.

- Create, maintain, and improve documentation and operational procedures for which operationnal ownership is ensured.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve and review governance around integration operations.

- Maintain high standards of data quality, reliability, and performance.

- Stay current with advancements in data engineering, of dataops tech stack, to support continuous improvement

Requirements and Qualifications

- At least 5 Years of proven hands-on experience in data engineering and data pipeline deployment rooted in devops practice.

- Comfortable working with Python, SQL, PySpark and Databricks

- Robust experience of any leading CI/CD platforms and processes in hybrid environment (e.g., Azure DevOps, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions ).

- Familiarity with microservices architecture, API management and observability is a real plus

- Experienced with Azure databricks.

- Good communication and collaboration skills.

- Rigorous and methodical in documentation and process creation

- High interest for convergence, normalization and reusability.

- Curious, enthusiastic and proactive

- Passionate about data processing technologies, with a strong desire to learn and grow in a demanding environment

- Fluent in spoken and written English, French is an asset.

- Hands-on: Being proactive to rapidly deliver high-quality results

- Passionate: Being committed and striving for excellence

- Solution-driven: Focusing on client outcomes and treating clients fairly with a risk-aware mindset

- Partnership-oriented: Promoting collaboration and teamwork. Working together with an entrepreneurial spirit.

La nostra azienda

EFG International è un gruppo bancario privato globale, che offre servizi di private banking e asset management. Serviamo clienti in oltre 40 sedi in tutto il mondo. EFG International offre un ambiente di lavoro stimolante e dinamico e si sforza di essere un datore di lavoro di scelta.

Il nostro scopo e missione

Incoraggiare le menti imprenditoriali a creare valore – oggi e per il futuro.

Descrizione del lavoro

La missione del team di piattaforma DataOps è garantire un livello di servizio affidabile in ogni componente tecnologica della piattaforma dati EFG (Databricks, Kafka, Spark, Elastic Search, Apache MQ, uServices stack).

Stiamo costruendo ed evolvendo la piattaforma CI/CD che supporta le implementazioni delle pipeline di dati, portando competenze di implementazione e lavorando a stretto contatto con i team di progetto per ottenere consegnabili attraverso la linea.

Le responsabilità chiave del team includono, la governance CI/CD delle pipeline di dati, il supporto di distribuzione delle pipeline e la certificazione e il monitoraggio delle operazioni a livello di piattaforma.

Principali responsabilità

Mentre la nostra piattaforma e il panorama dei dati si evolvono, vorremmo rafforzare il nostro team con un ingegnere CI/CD specializzato nelle implementazioni delle pipeline di dati.
- Le aspettative sulla qualità dei dati sono in costante aumento con la necessità di una consegna di servizio estremamente stabile. Dobbiamo garantire che i nostri processi di consegna siano controllati e visibili ai nostri stakeholder.
- Siamo particolarmente interessati a qualcuno che guida le operazioni di Kafka, Spark e Databricks con Python
- Rinforzando il nostro team, contribuirai notevolmente alla continuità e alla qualità delle nostre operazioni.
- Assumere la proprietà operativa di specifici servizi di dati (gestione del cambiamento, gestione dell'assicurazione di qualità, SLA, SOP)

- tracciare e garantire il buon funzionamento dei datadotti critici durante le ore asiatiche, agendo come punto di contatto primario per problemi critici in un modello di supporto al sole.
- Progettare, implementare e ottimizzare la pipeline di dati in modalità batch e streaming.
- Seguire e applicare la pratica CI/CD per automatizzare e ottimizzare le implementazioni e le integrazioni.
- Creare, mantenere e migliorare la documentazione e le procedure operative per le quali è garantita la proprietà operativa.
- Collaborare con team interfunzionali per migliorare e rivedere la governance nelle operazioni di integrazione.
- Mantenere elevati standard di qualità dei dati, affidabilità e prestazioni.
- Mantenere corrente con progressi nell'ingegneria dei dati, di dataops tech stack, per supportare il miglioramento continuo

Requisiti e qualifiche
- Almeno 5 anni di comprovata esperienza pratica nell'ingegneria dei dati e nell'implementazione delle pipeline di dati radicate nella pratica dei devoti.
- Confortevole lavoro con Python, SQL, PySpark e Databricks
- Robusta esperienza di tutte le principali piattaforme e processi CI/CD in ambiente ibrido (ad esempio, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions ).
- La familiarità con l'architettura dei microservizi, la gestione delle API e l'osservabilità è un vantaggio reale
- Esperienza con i databrick Azure.
- Buone capacità di comunicazione e collaborazione.
- Rigoroso e metodico nella documentazione e nella creazione di processi
- Alto interesse per la convergenza, la normalizzazione e la riutilizzabilità.
- Curioso, entusiasta e proattivo
- Appassionato sulle tecnologie di elaborazione dei dati, con un forte desiderio di imparare e crescere in un ambiente esigente
- Fluente in inglese parlato e scritto, il francese è un bene.

I nostri valori
- Responsabilità: Prendere la proprietà per i compiti e le sfide, nonché cercare un miglioramento continuo
- Hands-on: essere proattivi per fornire rapidamente risultati di alta qualità
- Passionato: Impegnarsi e lottare per l'eccellenza
- Soluzione-driven: Concentrarsi sui risultati del cliente e trattare i clienti in modo corretto con una mentalità di rischio-consapevole
- Partnership-oriented: promuovere la collaborazione e il lavoro di squadra. Lavorare insieme a uno spirito imprenditoriale.
