jobs.description:
General Info

-
Department : Information Security & BCM

-
Work time Percentage : 100%

-
Location : Geneva (preferred), Zurich or Lugano

## Job Description

Context - The Information Security & BCM, under the lead of the Group Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) and part of the Chief Operating Officer (COO) organization, defines, leads, and coordinates information security efforts across EFG International and its entities globally. It outlines the information security strategy, identifies, and runs security initiatives and sets standards.

To support the ICT Risk Management Framework, in compliance with regulatory requirements (FINMA, DORA and relevant financial-sector regulations), we are looking for a Cybersecurity Intermal Penetration Tester.

The successful candidate will be responsible for performing ongoing, in-house offensive security assessments of the Bank’s infrastructure, applications and controls.

This role combines hands-on technical experience conducting penetration testing and simulating real-world attacks exercises on corporate environments, with close collaboration with Security, IT, development and risk teams to proactively identify, exploit and advise on the remediation of vulnerabilities in critical banking systems.

## Key responsibilities include

-
Plan, scope and execute internal penetration tests on core banking platforms and business applications, with a strong focus on services supporting critical and important functions

-
Design test scenarios aligned with realistic baking threat models (fraud, data exfiltration, privilege escalation, lateral movements to critical systems,…) and internal risk assessments

-
Execute hands-on tests against internal networks, servers, endpoints, web applications, APIs, cloud workloads, AD and other core infrastructure systems

-
Document findings in clear, risk-based reports with evidence and actionable remediation guidance for technical and non-technical audiences

-
Work closely with infrastructure, development, DevOps and risk teams to support remediation plans and re-testing, ensuring critical findings are tracked to closure within the ICT risk and governance processes.

-
Develop and maintain internal testing methodologies, playbooks and tools to support repeatable and efficient assessments

-
Collaborate with SOC on purple-team style exercises to test and improve detection and response capabilities

-
Stay current on emerging threats, vulnerabilities, TTPs, etc, and incorporate into internal testing

## Skills and experience

-
Background in cybersecurity, computer science, or related fields

-
3-5 years of hands-on penetration testing or red-team experience, with demonstrable work on internal network, web applications and API; banking or financial services experience is a strong plus

-
Strong understanding of network protocols, operating systems (Windows, Linux), web and cloud technologies; familiarity with core banking architectures is a plus

-
Proficiency with common offensive tools and techniques (e.g. Burp Suite, Metasploit, Cobalt Strike-like frameworks, Kali-based tooling) and ability to perform manual testing beyond tools

-
Solid knowledge of secure coding concepts and common application vulnerabilities (e.g. OWASP Top 10) to assess web and API targets

-
Professional certifications such as OCSP, GXPN, or similar offensive security credentials in good standing

-
Strong communication skills and ability to explain complex technical findings to technical and non-technical audience

## Our Values

-
Accountability : Taking ownership for tasks and challenges, as well as seeking continuous improvement

-
Hands-on : Being proactive to rapidly deliver high-quality results

-
Passionate : Being committed and striving for excellence

-
Solution-driven : Focusing on client outcomes and treating clients fairly with a risk-aware mindset

-
Partnership-oriented : Promoting collaboration and teamwork. Working together with an entrepreneurial spirit.

## Application

Please ensure to attach a cover letter to your CV when filling the application.

Documenter les constatations dans des rapports clairs et fondés sur les risques, avec des preuves et des lignes directrices sur la remise en état à l'intention des publics techniques et non techniques
- Oui.
Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes d'infrastructure, de développement, de développement et de gestion des risques afin d'appuyer les plans d'assainissement et de re-test, en veillant à ce que les constatations critiques soient suivies jusqu'à la clôture des processus de gestion des risques et de gouvernance des TIC.
- Oui.
Élaborer et tenir à jour des méthodes d'essai internes, des livres de lecture et des outils pour appuyer les évaluations répétables et efficaces
- Oui.
Collaborer avec SOC sur des exercices de style pourpre-équipe pour tester et améliorer les capacités de détection et de réponse
- Oui.
Restez à jour sur les menaces émergentes, les vulnérabilités, les TTP, etc., et intégrer dans les tests internes

Contexte en matière de cybersécurité, d'informatique ou de domaines connexes
- Oui.

Empowering entrepreneurial minds to create value – today and for the future.

We are a private bank, offering personalised solutions on a global scale to private and institutional clients. Our sustainable success is based on our talents and on how we partner with our clients and communities to create lasting value.

Job Description

Context - The Information Security & BCM, under the lead of the Group Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) and part of the Chief Operating Officer (COO) organization, defines, leads, and coordinates information security efforts across EFG International and its entities globally. It outlines the information security strategy, identifies, and runs security initiatives and sets standards.

To support the ICT Risk Management Framework, in compliance with regulatory requirements (FINMA, DORA and relevant financial-sector regulations), we are looking for a Cybersecurity Intermal Penetration Tester.

The successful candidate will be responsible for performing ongoing, in-house offensive security assessments of the Bank’s infrastructure, applications and controls.

This role combines hands-on technical experience conducting penetration testing and simulating real-world attacks exercises on corporate environments, with close collaboration with Security, IT, development and risk teams to proactively identify, exploit and advise on the remediation of vulnerabilities in critical banking systems.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Plan, scope and execute internal penetration tests on core banking platforms and business applications, with a strong focus on services supporting critical and important functions

  • Design test scenarios aligned with realistic baking threat models (fraud, data exfiltration, privilege escalation, lateral movements to critical systems,…) and internal risk assessments

  • Execute hands-on tests against internal networks, servers, endpoints, web applications, APIs, cloud workloads, AD and other core infrastructure systems

  • Document findings in clear, risk-based reports with evidence and actionable remediation guidance for technical and non-technical audiences

  • Work closely with infrastructure, development, DevOps and risk teams to support remediation plans and re-testing, ensuring critical findings are tracked to closure within the ICT risk and governance processes.

  • Develop and maintain internal testing methodologies, playbooks and tools to support repeatable and efficient assessments

  • Collaborate with SOC on purple-team style exercises to test and improve detection and response capabilities

  • Stay current on emerging threats, vulnerabilities, TTPs, etc, and incorporate into internal testing

Skills and experience

  • Background in cybersecurity, computer science, or related fields

  • 3-5 years of hands-on penetration testing or red-team experience, with demonstrable work on internal network, web applications and API; banking or financial services experience is a strong plus

  • Strong understanding of network protocols, operating systems (Windows, Linux), web and cloud technologies; familiarity with core banking architectures is a plus

  • Proficiency with common offensive tools and techniques (e.g. Burp Suite, Metasploit, Cobalt Strike-like frameworks, Kali-based tooling) and ability to perform manual testing beyond tools

  • Solid knowledge of secure coding concepts and common application vulnerabilities (e.g. OWASP Top 10) to assess web and API targets

  • Professional certifications such as OCSP, GXPN, or similar offensive security credentials in good standing

  • Strong communication skills and ability to explain complex technical findings to technical and non-technical audience

Our Values

  • Accountability: Taking ownership for tasks and challenges, as well as seeking continuous improvement

  • Hands-on: Being proactive to rapidly deliver high-quality results

  • Passionate: Being committed and striving for excellence

  • Solution-driven: Focusing on client outcomes and treating clients fairly with a risk-aware mindset

  • Partnership-oriented: Promoting collaboration and teamwork. Working together with an entrepreneurial spirit.

Application

Please ensure to attach a cover letter to your CV when filling the application.

EFG International offre un environnement de travail stimulant et dynamique et s'efforce d'être un employeur de choix. EFG s'engage à créer un environnement de travail équitable et inclusif fondé sur le principe du respect mutuel. Rejoindre notre équipe signifie vivre un environnement favorable, où vos contributions sont appréciées et reconnues. Nous croyons fermement que la diversité de nos équipes nous donne un avantage concurrentiel en favorisant une meilleure prise de décision et une plus grande innovation. Notre but et notre mission Donner aux esprits entrepreneurs les moyens de créer de la valeur – aujourd'hui et pour l'avenir. Nous sommes une banque privée, offrant des solutions personnalisées à l'échelle mondiale aux clients privés et institutionnels. Notre succès durable repose sur nos talents et sur la façon dont nous collaborons avec nos clients et nos collectivités pour créer une valeur durable. Description du travail L'équipe IT Treasury and Trading fournit un soutien et des solutions informatiques efficaces et efficaces pour les applications et les processus d'exécution des ordres de clients, de négociation, de trésorerie et de gestion des prêts et des garanties. L'équipe est composée d'experts fonctionnels et techniques qui soutiennent une salle de trading/trésorerie d'une cinquantaine de traders. Ce rôle assure la continuité des services à la clientèle et favorise l'amélioration continue de la qualité des produits.

## Principales responsabilités
- Exécuter la Banque : soutien de bout en bout sur les plates-formes de trading informatique utilisées pour l'exécution et le trading de titres de prêt et de garantie, de la finance islamique, des titres et dérivés, allant de la maintenance de l'application à l'analyse et à la résolution des incidents quotidiens, en liaison avec les fournisseurs externes, le cas échéant.
- Faire fonctionner la Banque en tant que point d'entrée vers le bureau de négociation pour des questions plus larges qui nécessitent la liaison avec d'autres services informatiques pour couvrir la pile complète (banque centrale et autres applications liées, serveur informatique, base de données, réseau, ...) ou avec des équipes d'exploitation (garanties, dérivés, back office FX, bureau intermédiaire)
- Modifier la Banque : coordonner et exécuter divers projets informatiques visant à développer ou à améliorer les plates-formes de négociation informatique, soit en interne, soit par des fournisseurs d'applications : collecte des besoins d'affaires, conception de solutions et documentation, développement le cas échéant et/ou coordination des fournisseurs, création d'un catalogue de cas d'essais et exécution de tests informatiques, soutien à l'acceptation par les utilisateurs test, déploiement et soutien à la production
- Modifier la Banque : développement d'applications départementales visant à combler les lacunes des applications informatiques existantes, principalement dans le domaine de l'intégration et de l'établissement de rapports
- Changer la Banque : gestion d'outils pour l'automatisation des contrôles de santé sur les plates-formes informatiques pour finalement garantir le service aux clients internes S'approprier les tâches et les défis, et chercher une amélioration continue
- Hands-on: Être proactif pour obtenir rapidement des résultats de haute qualité
- Passionné: S'engager et s'efforcer d'atteindre l'excellence
- Inspiré par la solution: Se concentrer sur les résultats des clients et traiter les clients de façon équitable en tenant compte des risques
- Orienté vers le partenariat: Promouvoir la collaboration et le travail d'équipe. Travailler ensemble avec un esprit d'entreprise.

jobs.title: Network & Proxy Support Team Lead
jobs.description:
General Information

- Department: Information Technology – Infrastructure

- Work Time Percentage: 100%

- Location: Geneva

Our Company

EFG International is a global private banking group, offering private banking and asset management services. We serve clients in over 40 locations worldwide. EFG International offers a stimulating and dynamic work environment and strives to be an employer of choice.

Our Purpose and Mission

Empowering entrepreneurial minds to create value – today and for the future.

Job Description

Role and Team

Within the Information Technology Department, you will join a team of 12 engineers based in Geneva and collaborate with IT colleagues in more than 30 countries. Under the supervision of the IT Infrastructure Support Manager, you will lead a team of three network engineers.

You will combine people management with hands-on engineering, ensuring that EFG’s business-critical systems remain secure, resilient, and always connected in a demanding private banking environment.

Main Responsibilities

1. Leadership & Management

- Lead, coach and develop a team of three network engineers, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement.

- Combine team leadership with hands-on technical work on complex incidents and projects.

- Oversee day-to-day network and proxy operations, including incident, problem and change management.

- Plan and coordinate network and proxy upgrades, migrations and lifecycle activities in alignment with business and security requirements.

- Manage escalations, ensuring timely resolution of major incidents and clear communication with stakeholders.

- Manage and review third-party providers and vendor contracts, ensuring service quality, cost effectiveness and adherence to SLAs.

- Ensure compliance with internal policies as well as regulatory, security and audit requirements relevant to network and security infrastructure.

2. Proxy / Secure Web Gateway (Zscaler)

- Collaborate closely with security teams to define, implement and maintain security policies, including URL filtering, cloud application and file filtering, DLP and access control.

- Configure, operate and maintain Zscaler solutions (ZIA, ZPA) and related components such as SIPA, cloud firewall, PAC files, NSS, ZCC...

- Manage corporate devices using Zscaler Client Connector (ZCC), ensuring secure and reliable connectivity.

- Troubleshoot and resolve Zscaler-related issues by analysing logs, performing traces and applying appropriate corrective actions.

- Analyse network packet traces (PCAP), Fiddler logs and HTTP/HTTPS headers to identify and resolve complex connectivity and performance issues.

- Proactively suggest and implement improvements to network and proxy performance, capacity, scalability and security posture.

3. Network Engineering & Operations

- Provide 2nd and 3rd level technical support for network and related services.

- Configure, install and maintain network devices and services (e.g. routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, VPN, QoS).

- Support and maintain network connectivity for financial market data feeds and other latency-sensitive services.

- Implement and maintain a continuous improvement process by defining, documenting and enforcing network and proxy standards, procedures and best practices.

- Interface with external suppliers and partners (integrators, telecom providers, market data vendors, etc.) to design, implement and support network solutions.

- Participate in 24x7 on-call / on-duty rotation (piquet) to support critical infrastructure.

- Monitor network and proxy performance, ensuring system availability, reliability and security.

Role and Team

Within the Information Technology Department, you will join a team of 12 engineers based in Geneva and collaborate with IT colleagues in more than 30 countries. Under the supervision of the IT Infrastructure Support Manager, you will lead a team of three network engineers.

You will combine people management with hands-on engineering, ensuring that EFG’s business-critical systems remain secure, resilient, and always connected in a demanding private banking environment.

Main Responsibilities

1. Leadership & Management

  • Lead, coach and develop a team of three network engineers, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement.
  • Combine team leadership with hands-on technical work on complex incidents and projects.
  • Oversee day-to-day network and proxy operations, including incident, problem and change management.
  • Plan and coordinate network and proxy upgrades, migrations and lifecycle activities in alignment with business and security requirements.
  • Manage escalations, ensuring timely resolution of major incidents and clear communication with stakeholders.
  • Manage and review third-party providers and vendor contracts, ensuring service quality, cost effectiveness and adherence to SLAs.
  • Ensure compliance with internal policies as well as regulatory, security and audit requirements relevant to network and security infrastructure.

2. Proxy / Secure Web Gateway (Zscaler)

  • Collaborate closely with security teams to define, implement and maintain security policies, including URL filtering, cloud application and file filtering, DLP and access control.
  • Configure, operate and maintain Zscaler solutions (ZIA, ZPA) and related components such as SIPA, cloud firewall, PAC files, NSS, ZCC...
  • Manage corporate devices using Zscaler Client Connector (ZCC), ensuring secure and reliable connectivity.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve Zscaler-related issues by analysing logs, performing traces and applying appropriate corrective actions.
  • Analyse network packet traces (PCAP), Fiddler logs and HTTP/HTTPS headers to identify and resolve complex connectivity and performance issues.
  • Proactively suggest and implement improvements to network and proxy performance, capacity, scalability and security posture.

3. Network Engineering & Operations

  • Provide 2nd and 3rd level technical support for network and related services.
  • Configure, install and maintain network devices and services (e.g. routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, VPN, QoS).
  • Support and maintain network connectivity for financial market data feeds and other latency-sensitive services.
  • Implement and maintain a continuous improvement process by defining, documenting and enforcing network and proxy standards, procedures and best practices.
  • Interface with external suppliers and partners (integrators, telecom providers, market data vendors, etc.) to design, implement and support network solutions.
  • Participate in 24x7 on-call / on-duty rotation (piquet) to support critical infrastructure.
  • Monitor network and proxy performance, ensuring system availability, reliability and security.
  • Monitor system resource utilisation, trends and capacity, and plan upgrades or optimisations accordingly.

Skills and Experience

Background

  • 6–10 years of experience in networking in complex, international environments.
  • Strong knowledge of enterprise networking architecture and network security.
  • Professional experience with Cisco technologies and Cisco ACI; financial services experience is a plus.

Technical Skills

  • Expert in LAN/WAN/MAN implementation and troubleshooting.
  • Strong experience with firewalls (Fortinet and/or Check Point), VPN, IPSec and GRE tunnels.
  • Proven expertise with Zscaler ZIA/ZPA and ZCC on corporate devices.
  • Solid understanding of network and cloud connectivity design.
  • Ability to analyse network traces (PCAP), Fiddler logs and HTTP/HTTPS headers.
  • Knowledge of Python or another scripting language for automation; Zscaler certification is a plus.

Soft Skills & Languages

  • Strong communication skills; able to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience managing third-party providers and internal support teams.
  • Rigorous, autonomous, proactive and service-oriented, with strong documentation skills.
  • Fluent in French and English, written and spoken.

Our Values

  • Accountability: Taking ownership for tasks and challenges, as well as seeking continuous improvement.
  • Hands-on: Being proactive to rapidly deliver high-quality results.
  • Passionate: Being committed and striving for excellence.
  • Solution-driven: Focusing on client outcomes and treating clients fairly with a risk-aware mindset.
  • Partnership-oriented: Promoting collaboration and teamwork; working together with an entrepreneurial spirit.

Application

  1. Please ensure you attach a cover letter to your CV when submitting your application.
  2. Should you wish to apply for this position, please use the designated application link.

jobs.title: Investment Risk Specialist
jobs.description:
## Job Description

To act as a strategic partner across all service lines, providing the discipline that secures EFG’s growth ambitions. The role owns the group‑wide investment risk and analytics agenda, transforming complex market data into actionable conviction and embedding institutional‑grade oversight across Advisory, New Capital, and Discretionary Portfolio Management (DPM).

Combining deep technical expertise with a broad strategic remit, this position sets direction for investment risk frameworks, leads cross‑functional initiatives, and ensures that risk‑intelligent growth is consistently delivered across the franchise

Key Responsibilities

- Strategic Leadership & Framework Ownership :
- Define and own the investment risk and analytics framework for Advisory, ensuring consistency, robustness, and alignment with EFG’s risk appetite and investment philosophy.

- Translate the global investment strategy into concrete risk and analytics standards, methodologies, and processes across Advisory, New Capital, and DPM.

- Act as the recognised senior authority on investment risk and analytics, providing guidance to senior management and key governance bodies

- Ownership of Portfolio Risk Measurement for Advisory
- Own the end ‑ to ‑ end Product and Portfolio Risk Measurement for Advisory, including: the Product Risk Classification (PRC) and the related quality controls and the aggregation to a portfolio risk measurement

- Lead the Globalization of the Product and Portfolio Risk Measurement for Advisory into Asia with the result that around the globe EFG uses consistent and aligned risk measurements

- Define and lead the evolution from todays Prodcut risk Score to a more sophisticated, Aladdin ‑ enabled measures (e.g. factor ‑ based risk, scenario analysis, stress testing, liquidity and concentration metrics).

- Ensure that Portfolio Risk Measurement for Advisory is fully embedded in advisory processes, portfolio construction, and client communication.

- Risk‑Driven Culture & Franchise Leadership:
- Lead a cultural shift in the first line of defence by positioning risk management as a core part across all our solutions.

- Drive the adoption of independent, high‑quality risk analytics on funds and portfolios, and embed portfolio risk measurement into everyday practices.

-
Lead and deliver multiple cross‑functional projects to enhance investment risk and analytics frameworks, using these initiatives to strengthen each franchise, improve transparency, and demonstrate that disciplined risk management supports better, faster, and more confident investment decisions.

- CIO Investment Framework
- Play a key role in shaping the bank’s long‑term investment stance by contributing to the quantitative process and qualitative overlay for 7–10 year Capital Market Assumptions and their translation into strategic asset allocation.

- Actively engage in the Global Investment Committee to challenge risk‑taking, ensure portfolios remain aligned with the house view, and bring a disciplined risk and analytics perspective into core investment governance.

-
Innovation and Automation: Actively seek to introduce new ideas—including Power BI dashboards, intranet enhancements, and process automation—to improve transparency and efficiency.

Skills and Qualifications

- Education: Master’s degree in Banking and Finance.

- Certification: CFA Level III, demonstrating a commitment to professional development and technical excellence.

- Experience: at least 8-10 years of experience within the bank, with a proven track record of delivering analytical and project-based value across investment areas.

- Technical Proficiency: Advanced proficiency in Excel, Python Bloomberg, and Power BI, alongside experience with risk engines like Aladdin is a plus.

- Domain Knowledge: Strong understanding of investment products, risk concepts, and cross-asset correlations .

- Driven by Accountability: Focuses on driving results and building trust to power growth.

- Powered by Insight: Utilizes data-driven insights for continuous improvement and smart decision-making.

- Safety and Agility: Maintains the balance between institutional safety and the agility required to create unrivalled client value.

Our Values

- Accountability: Taking ownership for tasks and challenges, as well as seeking continuous improvement

- Hands-on: Being proactive to rapidly deliver high-quality results

- Passionate: Being committed and striving for excellence

- Solution-driven: Focusing on client outcomes and treating clients fairly with a risk-aware mindset

- Partnership-oriented: Promoting collaboration and teamwork. Working together with an entrepreneurial spirit.

Descrizione del lavoro

Agire come partner strategico in tutte le linee di servizio, fornendo la disciplina che assicura le ambizioni di crescita di EFG. Il ruolo possiede l'agenda dei rischi di investimento a livello di gruppo e dell'analisi, trasformando i dati di mercato complessi in convinzione attuabile e integrando la supervisione di livello istituzionale attraverso Advisory, New Capital e Discretionary Portfolio Management (DPM).

Combinando competenze tecniche profonde con un ampio remit strategico, questa posizione imposta la direzione per i framework di rischio di investimento, conduce iniziative interfunzionali e assicura che la crescita intelligente del rischio sia costantemente consegnata attraverso il franchising

Principali responsabilità
- Leadership strategica e proprietà quadro:
- Definire e possedere il quadro di rischio di investimento e analisi per Advisory, assicurando coerenza, robustezza e allineamento con l’appetito di rischio di EFG e la filosofia di investimento.
- Traduci la strategia di investimento globale in standard di rischio e analisi concrete, metodologie e processi in Advisory, New Capital e DPM.
- Atto come l'autorità senior riconosciuta sul rischio di investimento e analisi, fornendo indicazioni agli enti di gestione senior e di governance chiave
- ProprietÃ della misura del rischio Portfolio per Advisory
- Misurazione del rischio di prodotto e del portafoglio per i consulenti, compresa: la classificazione del rischio di prodotto (PRC) e i relativi controlli di qualità e l'aggregazione a una misurazione del rischio di portafoglio
- Condurre la Globalizzazione del Misuratore di rischio prodotto e portafoglio per Advisory in Asia con il risultato che in tutto il mondo EFG utilizza misure di rischio coerenti e allineate
- Definire e condurre l'evoluzione da oggi Prodcut rischio Punteggio ad una più sofisticata, Aladdin ‐ abilitato misure (ad esempio rischio basato fattore, analisi scenari, test di stress, liquidità e metriche di concentrazione).
- Assicurarsi che Portfolio Risk Measurement for Advisory sia completamente integrato in processi di consulenza, costruzione di portafoglio e comunicazione client.
- Risk-Driven Culture & Leadership:
- Condurre un cambiamento culturale nella prima linea di difesa posizionando la gestione del rischio come parte integrante di tutte le nostre soluzioni.
- Guidare l'adozione di analisi di rischio indipendenti e di alta qualità su fondi e portafogli, e incorporare la misurazione del rischio portafoglio nelle pratiche quotidiane.
- Condurre e fornire progetti multifunzionali per migliorare il rischio di investimento e i framework di analisi, utilizzando queste iniziative per rafforzare ogni franchising, migliorare la trasparenza e dimostrare che la gestione del rischio disciplinata supporta decisioni di investimento migliori, più veloci e più sicure.
- No.
- CIO Investment Framework
- Svolgere un ruolo chiave nella definizione della posizione di investimento a lungo termine della banca contribuendo al processo quantitativo e alla sovrapposizione qualitativa per 7-10 anni Capital Market Assunzioni e alla loro traduzione in assetto strategico.
- Impegnarsi attivamente nel Global Investment Committee per sfidare l'assunzione del rischio, garantire che i portafogli rimangano allineati con la vista della casa, e portare una prospettiva di rischio disciplinata e di analisi nel core governance degli investimenti.
- No.
Innovazione e Automazione: cercare attivamente di introdurre nuove idee, tra cui cruscotti Power BI, miglioramenti intranet e automazione dei processi, per migliorare la trasparenza e l'efficienza.

Competenze e qualifiche
- Istruzione: Master in Banca e Finanza.
- Certificazione: CFA Livello III, dimostrando un impegno per lo sviluppo professionale e l'eccellenza tecnica.
- Esperienza: almeno 8-10 anni di esperienza all'interno della banca, con un comprovato track record di fornitura di valore analitico e basato sul progetto in aree di investimento.
- Proficienza tecnica: competenza avanzata in Excel, Python Bloomberg e Power BI, insieme all'esperienza con motori a rischio come Aladdin è un plus.
- Conoscenza del dominio: Forte comprensione dei prodotti di investimento, concetti di rischio e correlazioni cross-asset .
- Guidato dalla Responsabilità: si concentra sui risultati della guida e sulla fiducia nella crescita del potere.
- Powered by Insight: Utilizza le informazioni basate sui dati per il miglioramento continuo e il processo decisionale intelligente.
- Sicurezza e Agility: Mantiene l'equilibrio tra sicurezza istituzionale e l'agilità necessaria per creare valore cliente senza rivalità.

I nostri valori
- Responsabilità: Prendere la proprietà per i compiti e le sfide, nonché cercare un miglioramento continuo
- Hands-on: essere proattivi per fornire rapidamente risultati di alta qualità
- Passionato: Impegnarsi e lottare per l'eccellenza
- Soluzione-driven: Concentrarsi sui risultati del cliente e trattare i clienti in modo corretto con una mentalità di rischio-consapevole
- Partnership-oriented: promuovere la collaborazione e il lavoro di squadra. Lavorare insieme a uno spirito imprenditoriale.

Job Description

Als strategischer Partner in allen Servicelinien zu fungieren und die Disziplin zu schaffen, die die Wachstumsambitionen der EFG sichert. Die Rolle besitzt die konzernweite Investitionsrisiko- und Analytik-Agenda, die komplexe Marktdaten in eine handlungsfähige Überzeugung umwandelt und institutionelle Aufsicht über das Advisory, New Capital und Diskretion Portfolio Management (DPM) einbettet.

Diese Position kombiniert tiefes technisches Know-how mit einem breiten strategischen Remit, setzt Richtung für Investment-Risiko-Frameworks, führt funktionsübergreifende Initiativen und stellt sicher, dass risikointelligentes Wachstum im gesamten Franchise-Bereich konsequent ausgeliefert wird

Hauptverantwortlichkeiten
- Strategische Führung und Rahmenbesitz :
- Definieren und besitzen Sie den Rahmen für das Investitionsrisiko und die Analytik für die Beratung, die Gewährleistung von Konsistenz, Robustheit und die Ausrichtung auf die Risikobereitschaft und Investitionsphilosophie der EFG.
- Übersetzen Sie die globale Investitionsstrategie in konkrete Risiko- und Analysestandards, Methoden und Prozesse über Advisory, New Capital und DPM.
- Gesetz als anerkannte leitende Behörde für Investitionsrisiko und Analytik, die Leitlinien für leitende Management- und Schlüsselverwaltungsgremien
- Eigentum an Portfolio-Risikomessung für Beratung
- Besitzen Sie das Ende ‐ bis ‐ end Product and Portfolio Risk Measurement for Advisory, einschließlich: die Product Risk Classification (PRC) und die damit verbundenen Qualitätskontrollen und die Aggregation einer Portfolio-Risikomessung
- Führen Sie die Globalisierung der Produkt- und Portfolio-Risikomessung für das Beraten in Asien mit dem Ergebnis, dass EFG weltweit konsequente und ausgerichtete Risikomessungen verwendet
- Definieren und führen Sie die Entwicklung aus dem heutigen Staatsrisiko Ergebnis zu einer anspruchsvolleren, Aladdin ‐fähigen Maßnahmen (z.B. faktorbasiertes Risiko, Szenarioanalyse, Stresstests, Liquiditäts- und Konzentrationsmetriken).
- Stellen Sie sicher, dass Portfolio Risk Measurement for Advisory vollständig in Beratungsprozesse, Portfoliobau und Kundenkommunikation eingebettet ist.
- Risikoorientierte Kultur & Franchise Leadership:
- Führen Sie eine kulturelle Verschiebung in der ersten Verteidigungslinie durch die Positionierung von Risikomanagement als Kernteil über alle unsere Lösungen.
- Führen Sie die Einführung unabhängiger, qualitativ hochwertiger Risikoanalysen auf Fonds und Portfolios sowie die Einbindung von Portfolio-Risikomessungen in alltägliche Praktiken.
- Führen und liefern Sie mehrere funktionsübergreifende Projekte, um das Investitionsrisiko und die analytischen Rahmenbedingungen zu verbessern, indem Sie diese Initiativen nutzen, um jeden Franchise zu stärken, Transparenz zu verbessern und zu zeigen, dass diszipliniertes Risikomanagement bessere, schnellere und sicherere Investitionsentscheidungen unterstützt.
- Ja.
- CIO Investitionsrahmen
- Spielen Sie eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Gestaltung der langfristigen Anlagehaltung der Bank, indem Sie zum quantitativen Prozess und qualitativen Overlay für die 7–10-Jahre Capital Market Assumptions und ihre Übersetzung in die strategische Asset Allocation beitragen.
- Aktiv in das Global Investment Committee eingebunden, um Risiken zu bewältigen, Portfolios mit Blick auf das Haus zu vereinbaren und eine disziplinierte Risiko- und Analyseperspektive in die zentrale Investment Governance zu bringen.
- Ja.
Innovation und Automatisierung: Aktiv wollen neue Ideen einführen – darunter Power BI Dashboards, Intranet-Erweiterungen und Prozessautomatisierung – um Transparenz und Effizienz zu verbessern.

Fähigkeiten und Qualifikationen
- Ausbildung: Masterstudium Banking und Finanzen.
- Zertifizierung: CFA Level III, die ein Engagement für professionelle Entwicklung und technische Exzellenz zeigen.
- Erfahrung: mindestens 8-10 Jahre Erfahrung innerhalb der Bank, mit einem nachgewiesenen Erfolgsrekord, analytischen und projektbasierten Wert in Investitionsbereichen zu liefern.
- Technische Effizienz: Fortgeschrittene Kenntnisse in Excel, Python Bloomberg und Power BI, zusammen mit der Erfahrung mit Risikomotoren wie Aladdin ist ein Plus.
- Domain Knowledge: Ein starkes Verständnis von Investitionsprodukten, Risikokonzepten und Cross-Asset-Korrelationen .
- Angetrieben durch Rechenschaftspflicht: Fokussiert auf das Fahren von Ergebnissen und das Vertrauen auf das Stromwachstum.
- Powered by Insight: Nutzen Sie datengesteuerte Erkenntnisse für kontinuierliche Verbesserung und intelligente Entscheidungsfindung.
- Sicherheit und Agilität: Bewahrt das Gleichgewicht zwischen der institutionellen Sicherheit und der Agilität, die erforderlich ist, um unübertroffenen Kundenwert zu schaffen.

Unsere Werte
- Rechenschaftspflicht: Eigentumsbesitz für Aufgaben und Herausforderungen sowie kontinuierliche Verbesserung
- Hands-on: Als proaktiv, um schnell qualitativ hochwertige Ergebnisse zu liefern
- Leidenschaftlich: Engagement und Streben nach Exzellenz
- Lösungsgetrieben: Konzentrieren Sie sich auf Client-Ergebnisse und Behandlung von Kunden ziemlich mit einem risikobewussten Mindset
- Partnerschaftsorientiert: Förderung von Zusammenarbeit und Teamarbeit. Zusammenarbeit mit einem Unternehmergeist.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Description de l'emploi

Agir en tant que partenaire stratégique dans toutes les lignes de service, en fournissant la discipline qui garantit les ambitions de croissance de l'EFG. Ce rôle est le propriétaire du programme de gestion des risques d'investissement et d'analyse à l'échelle du groupe, transformant des données de marché complexes en conviction concrète et intégrant la surveillance de niveau institutionnel dans la gestion de portefeuille discrétionnaire (DGP) des services consultatifs et des nouveaux capitaux.

Combinant une expertise technique approfondie à un vaste mandat stratégique, ce poste définit l'orientation des cadres de risque d'investissement, dirige des initiatives interfonctionnelles et veille à ce que la croissance axée sur l'intelligence des risques soit constamment assurée dans l'ensemble de la franchise.

Principales responsabilités
- Leadership stratégique et propriété du cadre :
- Définir et posséder le cadre de risque d'investissement et d'analyse pour la consultation, en assurant la cohérence, la robustesse et l'alignement avec la philosophie de risque et d'investissement de l'EFG.
- Traduire la stratégie globale d'investissement en normes, méthodologies et processus concrets de risque et d'analyse dans l'ensemble des secteurs de la consultation, du nouveau capital et du DPM.
- Agir en tant qu'autorité supérieure reconnue en matière de risques d'investissement et d'analyse, en fournissant des conseils aux cadres supérieurs et aux principaux organes de gouvernance
- Propriété de la mesure des risques du portefeuille pour consultation
- Posséder la mesure finale des risques pour les produits et les portefeuilles à des fins de consultation, y compris : la classification des risques pour les produits (CPR) et les contrôles de qualité connexes et l'agrégation à une mesure des risques pour les portefeuilles
- Diriger la mondialisation de la mesure des risques liés aux produits et aux portefeuilles en Asie, avec pour résultat que partout dans le monde EFG utilise des mesures des risques cohérentes et alignées
- Définir et diriger l'évolution du risque Prodcut d'aujourd'hui Score vers des mesures plus sophistiquées, rendues possibles par Aladdin (p. ex. risque fondé sur les facteurs, analyse de scénarios, tests de stress, mesures de liquidité et de concentration).
- Veiller à ce que la mesure du risque du portefeuille pour les avis soit entièrement intégrée aux processus consultatifs, à la construction du portefeuille et à la communication avec les clients.
- Culture axée sur le risque et leadership en franchise :
- Diriger un changement culturel dans la première ligne de défense en plaçant la gestion des risques au cœur de toutes nos solutions.
- Favoriser l'adoption d'analyses de risque indépendantes et de haute qualité sur les fonds et les portefeuilles, et intégrer la mesure des risques de portefeuille dans les pratiques quotidiennes.
- Diriger et exécuter de multiples projets interfonctionnels afin d'améliorer les cadres de risque et d'analyse en matière d'investissement, en utilisant ces initiatives pour renforcer chaque franchise, améliorer la transparence et démontrer que la gestion des risques disciplinée favorise de meilleures décisions d'investissement, plus rapides et plus confiantes.
- Oui.
- Cadre d'investissement des DPI
- Jouer un rôle clé dans l'orientation à long terme de la banque en contribuant au processus quantitatif et au recouvrement qualitatif pour les hypothèses du marché des capitaux de 7 à 10 ans et leur traduction en répartition stratégique des actifs.
- S'engager activement au sein du Comité mondial de l'investissement pour remettre en question la prise de risques, veiller à ce que les portefeuilles restent alignés sur le point de vue de la maison et intégrer une perspective de risque et d'analyse disciplinée dans la gouvernance de l'investissement de base.
- Oui.
Innovation et automatisation : s'efforcer activement d'introduire de nouvelles idées – y compris des tableaux de bord Power BI, des améliorations intranet et l'automatisation des processus – pour améliorer la transparence et l'efficacité.

Compétences et qualifications
- Études : Maîtrise en Banque et Finance.
- Certification : CFA Niveau III, démontrant un engagement en faveur du perfectionnement professionnel et de l'excellence technique.
- Expérience : au moins 8 à 10 ans d'expérience au sein de la banque, avec une expérience éprouvée de la fourniture d'une valeur analytique et d'un projet dans tous les domaines d'investissement.
- Compétences techniques : Compétences avancées en Excel, Python Bloomberg et Power BI, ainsi que l'expérience avec les moteurs à risque comme Aladdin est un plus.
- Connaissance du domaine : Une bonne compréhension des produits d'investissement, des concepts de risque et des corrélations entre les actifs.
- Inspiré par la responsabilisation : met l'accent sur les résultats et le renforcement de la confiance dans la croissance du pouvoir.
- Powered by Insight: Utilise des informations basées sur les données pour une amélioration continue et une prise de décision intelligente.
- Sécurité et agilité : maintient l'équilibre entre la sécurité institutionnelle et l'agilité nécessaire pour créer une valeur client inégalée.

Nos valeurs
- Responsabilité : prise en charge des tâches et des défis, et recherche d'améliorations continues
- Hands-on: être proactif pour obtenir rapidement des résultats de haute qualité
- Passionné : être engagé et viser l'excellence
- Déterminé par la solution : se concentrer sur les résultats des clients et traiter les clients de façon équitable en tenant compte des risques
- Objectif partenariat : promouvoir la collaboration et le travail d'équipe. Travailler ensemble avec un esprit d'entreprise.

jobs.title: CIS Specialist Onboarding & Periodic Reviews Compliance Officer
jobs.description:
## Job Description

You will be joining an international, dynamic and highly skilled team of 20 colleagues based either in Zürich, Geneva or Lugano with a variety of backgrounds, languages and experience. We offer exciting opportunities to develop your compliance skill-set in a high-stakes and visible role with extensive Front Office contact.

Main responsibilities

- Client onboarding performing standard and enhanced AML/TF due due diligence for Client onboarding and Russian/Commonwealth of Independent States (CIS) markets analysis, with likely more complex reviews than standards

- Periodic review process: performing enhanced AML/TF due diligence for High Risk/Special High Risk/PEP cases as well as complex cases and CIS analysis

- Provide advice and support to the Front Office on all matters relating to KYC/AML (incl. CIS)

- Presentation of HRC/PEP/SHRC cases to the Client Acceptance Committee providing relevant risk assessments and succinct compliance recommendations

Skills and experience

- 5+ years prior experience in compliance roles, spanning KYC AML/TF, Transaction monitoring CDB/FATCA in Swiss Private Bank

- Proven CIS markets knowledge and experience is a must.

- Principled, self-driven and acting with integrity

- Superior attention to detail in order to identify and correct risky practices, while not losing sight of the big picture

- Must be a strong communicator, resolve conflict and capable of expressing oneself clearly both speaking and in writing

- Possess a collaborative personality and be open to suggestions from team members

- Demonstrate strong knowledge of industry protocols and best practices

- Strong time management and organizational skills and able to meet tight deadlines on Compliance remediation programs

- Ability to work under pressure and flexibility to deal with unexpected problems and tasks effectively

- Excellent communication skills in English are a must. Russian and/or any CIS languages preferred but can be substituted by proven market knowledge . German, French and/or Italian a plus

- Dedication to fostering an inclusive culture and value diverse perspectives

Our values

- Accountability: Taking ownership for tasks and challenges as well as seeking continuous improvement

- Hands-on: Being proactive to rapidly deliver high-quality results

- Passionate: Being committed and striving for excellence

- Solution-driven: Focusing on client outcomes and treating clients fairly with a risk-aware mindset

- Partnership-oriented: Promoting collaboration and teamwork. Working together with an entrepreneurial spirit.

Descrizione del lavoro

Ti unirai a un team internazionale, dinamico e altamente qualificato di 20 colleghi con sede a Zurigo, Ginevra o Lugano con una varietà di sfondi, lingue ed esperienze. Principali responsabilità
- Client onboarding esecutivo standard e potenziato AML/TF due diligence per il cliente di bordo e russo/Comunità di analisi dei mercati degli Stati Indipendenti (CIS), con recensioni probabilmente più complesse rispetto agli standard

- fornire consulenza e supporto all'Ufficio di presidenza su tutte le questioni relative a KYC/AML (incl. CIS)

Competenze ed esperienza

- 5+ anni di esperienza precedente nei ruoli di conformità, con KYC AML/TF, Transaction monitoring CDB/FATCA in Swiss Private Bank
- La comprovata conoscenza e l'esperienza dei mercati CIS è un must.
- Principiato, auto-guidato e agisce con integrità
- Superiora attenzione ai dettagli per identificare e correggere le pratiche rischiose, senza perdere di vista il grande quadro

- Possedere una personalità collaborativa ed essere aperto ai suggerimenti dei membri del team
- Dimostrare una forte conoscenza dei protocolli industriali e delle migliori pratiche

- Le eccellenti capacità di comunicazione in inglese sono un must. Russo e/o qualsiasi lingua CIS preferita ma può essere sostituita da una comprovata conoscenza del mercato. tedesco, francese e/o italiano

- Passionato: Impegnarsi e lottare per l'eccellenza

descriptionByLocale.de:
Job Description

Sie werden ein internationales, dynamisches und hochqualifiziertes Team von 20 Kollegen mit Sitz in Zürich, Genf oder Lugano mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, Sprachen und Erfahrungen aufnehmen. Wir bieten spannende Möglichkeiten, Ihr Compliance-Fähigkeitsset in einer hochauflösenden und sichtbaren Rolle mit umfangreichem Front Office-Kontakt zu entwickeln.

Hauptaufgaben
- Kunden an Bord, die Standard und verbesserte AML/TF Due Diligence für Client Onboarding und Russisch / Commonwealth of Independent States (CIS) Märkte Analyse, mit wahrscheinlich komplexeren Bewertungen als Standards
- Periodische Überprüfungsverfahren: verbesserte AML/TF Due Diligence für hohe Risiken/Special High Risk/PEP-Fälle sowie komplexe Fälle und CIS-Analyse
- Beratung und Unterstützung beim Front Office zu allen Fragen im Zusammenhang mit KYC/AML (inkl. CIS)
- Präsentation von HRC/PEP/SHRC-Fällen an den Client Acceptance Committee, die relevante Risikobewertungen und succinct Compliance-Empfehlungen liefern

Fähigkeiten und Erfahrung

- 5+ Jahre Erfahrung in Compliance-Rollen, über KYC AML/TF, Transaction Monitoring CDB/FATCA in der Schweizer Privatbank
- Proven CIS Märkte Wissen und Erfahrung ist ein Muss.
- Prinzipiell, selbstgesteuert und mit Integrität handeln
- Überlegene Liebe zum Detail, um riskante Praktiken zu identifizieren und zu korrigieren, während nicht zu verlieren Blick auf das große Bild
- Muss ein starker Kommunikator sein, Konflikt lösen und sich klar und schriftlich äußern können
- Possess eine kollaborative Persönlichkeit und offen für Vorschläge von Teammitgliedern
- Demonstrieren Sie starke Kenntnisse über Industrieprotokolle und bewährte Praktiken
- Starkes Zeitmanagement und organisatorische Fähigkeiten und in der Lage, enge Fristen zu Compliance-Remediationsprogrammen zu erfüllen
- Fähigkeit, unter Druck und Flexibilität zu arbeiten, um mit unerwarteten Problemen und Aufgaben effektiv zu umgehen
- Ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeiten auf Englisch sind ein Muss. Russische und/oder alle CIS-Sprachen bevorzugt, kann aber durch bewährte Marktkenntnisse ersetzt werden. Deutsch, Französisch und/oder Italienisch
- Hingabe, eine inklusive Kultur zu fördern und verschiedene Perspektiven zu schätzen

Unsere Werte
- Rechenschaftspflicht: Eigentum an Aufgaben und Herausforderungen sowie kontinuierliche Verbesserung suchen
- Hands-on: Als proaktiv, schnell qualitativ hochwertige Ergebnisse zu liefern
- Leidenschaftlich: Engagement und Streben nach Exzellenz
- Lösungsgetrieben: Konzentrieren Sie sich auf Client-Ergebnisse und Behandlung von Clients ziemlich mit einem risikobewussten Mindset
- Partnerschaftsorientiert: Förderung von Zusammenarbeit und Teamarbeit. Gemeinsam mit einem Unternehmergeist.

jobs.title: EFG Graduate Programme 2026 - Corporate Functions - Human Resources - Lugano
jobs.description:
We are looking for a young talent to join our EFG Graduate Programme – Corporate Functions path in Lugano , with a focus on Human Resources .

In this role, you will gain hands-on experience and valuable insight into the key areas that support and drive the success of EFG.

You will have the opportunity to work closely with our HR team, participate in talent acquisition, employee development, and performance management initiatives, and contribute to projects that shape EFG’s people strategy. This experience will provide you with a comprehensive understanding of how Human Resources enables EFG to deliver outstanding service and maintain its leadership in private banking.

How the EFG Graduate Programme works?

Starting in September 2026 and over a period of 18 months, the EFG Graduate Programme offers a challenging and exciting opportunity for recent graduates. Tailored on individual skills, interests, and competencies, the programme provides an ideal opportunity to obtain wide-ranging experience in an international and fast-growing private banking group:

- You will start with a 2-week onboarding in Switzerland to discover EFG Mission, Vision and Culture and start building your professional network.

- During the onboarding you will have the chance to attend specific trainings aimed at enhancing key competencies and communication skills.

- Continuous learning opportunities to ensure you develop both personally and professionally to achieve full potential.

- Buddy and Mentor to accompany you throughout the programme.

- Truly global, we have positions based in Miami, London, Luxembourg, Geneva, Zurich, Lugano, Singapore and Hong Kong.

Could you be one of our future graduates?

We value diversity and we do not require specific academic majors or industry experience, but look for different mix of background, experiences and skills.

## Our graduates are brilliant and enthusiastic talents, so we expect

- Bachelor or Master degree (completed in 2025 or on track to complete it) with outstanding academic results in a field with affinity with the selected professional path.

- Excellent English (any other language will be an advantage)

- International mindset

- Strong analytical, problem solving and organisational skills

- Forward thinking and able to suggest new ways of working to improve efficiency and competitiveness

- Self-disciplined, committed and with strong work ethics

- Adaptable and able to work collaboratively in a team environment with people from different backgrounds

- Client-oriented

- Proactive self-starter with intellectual curiosity

What will you get?

- Dynamic work experience by rotating through different teams and business units

- Experience an enriching international network

- Opportunity to build expertise in your chosen field and contribute to the EFG Culture

- Continuous development and learning opportunities on both technical and soft skills

The recruitment process for this position will begin in April 2026 and will include several interviews.

- Auto-disciplinato, impegnato e con un forte senso del dovere

summary:
We are looking for a young talent to join our EFG Graduate Programme – Corporate Functions path in Lugano, with a focus on Human Resources.

In this role, you will gain hands-on experience and valuable insight into the key areas that support and drive the success of EFG.

You will have the opportunity to work closely with our HR team, participate in talent acquisition, employee development, and performance management initiatives, and contribute to projects that shape EFG’s people strategy. This experience will provide you with a comprehensive understanding of how Human Resources enables EFG to deliver outstanding service and maintain its leadership in private banking.

How the EFG Graduate Programme works?

Starting in September 2026 and over a period of 18 months, the EFG Graduate Programme offers a challenging and exciting opportunity for recent graduates. Tailored on individual skills, interests, and competencies, the programme provides an ideal opportunity to obtain wide-ranging experience in an international and fast-growing private banking group:

  • You will start with a 2-week onboarding in Switzerland to discover EFG Mission, Vision and Culture and start building your professional network.
  • During the onboarding you will have the chance to attend specific trainings aimed at enhancing key competencies and communication skills.
  • Continuous learning opportunities to ensure you develop both personally and professionally to achieve full potential.
  • Buddy and Mentor to accompany you throughout the programme.
  • Truly global, we have positions based in Miami, London, Luxembourg, Geneva, Zurich, Lugano, Singapore and Hong Kong.

Could you be one of our future graduates?

We value diversity and we do not require specific academic majors or industry experience, but look for different mix of background, experiences and skills.

Our graduates are brilliant and enthusiastic talents, so we expect:

  • Bachelor or Master degree (completed in 2025 or on track to complete it) with outstanding academic results in a field with affinity with the selected professional path.
  • Excellent English (any other language will be an advantage)
  • International mindset
  • Strong analytical, problem solving and organisational skills
  • Forward thinking and able to suggest new ways of working to improve efficiency and competitiveness
  • Self-disciplined, committed and with strong work ethics
  • Adaptable and able to work collaboratively in a team environment with people from different backgrounds
  • Client-oriented
  • Proactive self-starter with intellectual curiosity

What will you get?

  • Dynamic work experience by rotating through different teams and business units
  • Experience an enriching international network
  • Opportunity to build expertise in your chosen field and contribute to the EFG Culture
  • Continuous development and learning opportunities on both technical and soft skills

The recruitment process for this position will begin in April 2026 and will include several interviews.
